任天堂设立新职位，旨在保存和整理其老游戏

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20261111/ugourtbuhdBkqwj.jpg!a-3-480x.jpg
任天堂北美分公司开设了一个新职位，旨在帮助保存和归档其庞大库中的旧游戏。
任天堂在其发展历程中已发布了约 11,000 款游戏。现在，该公司正寻求通过其位于华盛顿州雷德蒙德总部的专门职位来整理这些游戏——至少是那些较旧的游戏。
根据官方职位描述，任天堂北美未来的“历史系统数字档案员”将通过设计和实施“整理技术记录、工程文档、素材源码以及与遗产系统和平台相关的机构知识的结构化框架”，来支持“历史软硬件信息的保存、组织和可访问性”。
从本质上讲，数字档案员就像是一位图书管理员，其工作是创建一种组织和记录任天堂所有旧游戏、系统和平台以及与其相关的任何文档或材料的方法。对于电子游戏历史爱好者来说，这听起来绝对是一个有趣的角色，尤其是如果他们喜欢整理数据的话。
职位列表将理想候选人描述为拥有“档案、元数据管理、信息架构和研究方面的专业知识”的人，他们将与“工程、产品开发、法律和业务团队的领域专家密切合作”，以“建立标准和流程，确保历史信息保持可发现、可用并为后代保存”。
该职位为期 12 个月的合同工，时薪为 35 至 55 美元。拥有图书馆与信息科学、档案学、博物馆研究、信息管理、历史、技术传播或相关领域的学士学位者优先，但也可能考虑具有同等专业经验的人员。
这是电子游戏保存迈出的重要一步，该领域的活动人士和爱好者一段时间以来一直对此呼吁。例如，电子游戏历史基金会（Video Game History Foundation）成立于 2016 年，旨在保存和传授电子游戏历史。自那时起，它一直致力于建立美国首个专门研究电子游戏历史的图书馆，并保存游戏的源代码。
鉴于任天堂在游戏行业的影响力及其在媒介历史中的地位，该公司寻求归档其作品是合情合理的。也许这会带来一些意想不到的发现；例如，今年早些时候，一位收藏家发现了 97 份未发行版本的 Super Mario Bros. Duck Hunt，其中 5 份被 PSA 评为满分 10 分。

content.v: 世嘉与Sports Interactive推出的《 足球 经理27》已于11月10日在全平台上市。发售一天后，本作在Steam获得92%的好评率，评价档位为“特别好评”，同时在线人数超过7万。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261111/1794364973_672463.jpg
Metacritic收录的《足球经理27》媒体评价均分为81分，已经接近该系列以往通常处于80至85分的水平。现有数据表明，新作首发口碑较前作明显反弹。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261111/1794364974_616844.jpg
系列在改用Unity引擎后经历过一段不顺利的时期。开发周期延长曾导致《足球经理25》取消，玩家等待两年后才迎来《足球经理26》。该作虽然带来多项内容变革，却因界面难以适应和大量程序问题受到广泛批评。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261111/1794364974_893862_jpg_r.jpg
即使官方此后持续推出更新，截至相关数据统计时，《足球经理26》的Steam好评率仍为36%，Metacritic均分为68，也是该系列近十余年来少见的低分作品。
经过一年磨合，《足球经理27》对新引擎的适配已有改善，不少玩家反馈终于感受到明显进化。Sports Interactive还在正式上市前提供免费试玩，让玩家先确认游戏品质再决定是否购买。Steam评价与在线人数仍会随着新增评价和玩家进出发生变化。

content.v: Rockstar公开《GTA6》主机版以30fps为目标后，玩家社区围绕这一限制出现分歧。部分玩家和博主为这一选择辩护，也有人质疑不同游戏所受评价标准不一，并担心复杂场景下帧率无法稳定在30fps。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261111/1794364794_753356_jpg_r.jpg
包括社区账号GameRoll在内的部分作者认为，以《GTA6》的项目规模要求60fps并不现实。按照他们的判断，当前一代主机难以用双倍帧率处理其 开放世界 ，CPU提升有限的PS5 Pro也可能面临相同问题。若强行追求60fps，开发团队或许需要削减物理效果、场景对象密度、人群行为和复杂的环境模拟系统。
支持者还以《荒野大镖客：救赎2》为例，指出该作首发时同样以30fps运行，但动画、响应表现和整体画面仍让体验处于可接受范围。不过，这些性能取舍均为玩家和博主提出的技术判断，并非Rockstar公布的官方说明。
反对者则提到，《星空》发售时曾因类似的帧率限制遭到严厉批评，因此认为不同作品面对了双重标准。另一些玩家担心，“以30fps为目标”并不等于全程稳定在30fps，繁忙场景仍可能出现进一步下跌。更高帧率或许要等到PC版，但该版本的推出时间目前仍不清楚。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 4J Studios正在开发体素沙盒《重铸》，并将其定位为该类玩法的新选择。游戏采用工作室自研的Elements Engine，早期版本目前正在Xbox Series X和Xbox Series S上进行封闭测试。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261111/1794364419_885011_jpg_r.jpg
这支苏格兰团队曾长期负责《我的世界》官方主机版本。工作室主席Chris van der Kuyl表示，4J Studios无意取代或消灭《我的世界》，而是希望体素建造沙盒像第一人称射击游戏一样，发展成容纳多个大型作品的独立类型。
《重铸》面向2020年代的硬件和玩家需求设计，重点包括提高建造速度和数据处理效率。Elements Engine已秘密研发约9年，游戏本身则制作了约两年。其画面不再沿用传统像素风格，转而呈现细节更丰富的科幻环境，并结合程序生成、物理系统和地形平滑变形。
曾以Stampy Cat身份活跃的内容创作者Joseph Garrett现已成为工作室全职游戏设计师。他负责逻辑组件、磁悬浮运输线路建造工具，以及能够在游玩过程中设定特定重力规则的自定义区域。
4J Studios暂未选择先在Steam推出早期版本，而是将现阶段测试集中在固定规格的主机硬件上。当前封闭测试通过内部计划开展，覆盖Xbox Series X和Xbox Series S。

https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261111/1794364418_277943_jpg_r.jpg
本作是2016年前作时隔十年的续篇，舞台设在技术奇点后的近未来太阳系。后人类联盟、由自我意识AI建立的机械文明Substrate，以及新加入的地球联合军，将围绕太阳系霸权展开争夺。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261111/1794364421_492912_jpg_r.jpg

https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261111/1794364431_610010_jpg_r.jpg

content.v: Junkfish Limited于11月10日在Steam推出PC游戏《荒野暗影》，本作由Team Junkfish开发。游戏定价1900日元，11月18日前享受20%发售优惠，试玩版也已同步开放。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261111/1794364406_115554_jpg_r.jpg
《荒野暗影》采用第一人称视角，舞台是一座遍布受寄生生物感染恐龙的岛屿。玩家将扮演被派往当地的调查员，记录恐龙和植物的异常，并追查一支失踪探险队留下的线索。这支队伍曾由主角的父母带领，调查也因此与主角的个人经历相连。

https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261111/1794364413_605841_jpg_r.jpg

“有些问题，唯有子弹才能解决。”2036年，人类存亡危在旦夕。公安干员米莎穿梭于东京废墟驱逐妖怪，靠着临时政府的微薄赏金维持生计。随着激进组织“黄昏之刃”对隔离城“新千叶”发动恐袭，她勉强维持的平静宣告破裂。
为揪出主谋，米莎紧追“黄昏之刃”神秘头目“月读剑”，却深陷交织着阴谋、献祭与背叛的深渊。操控米莎，在群妖乱舞的东京废墟中突围。融合生死一线的紧张射击感，以及灵感源自格斗游戏的精准且富有成就感的玩法机制，双管齐下，拼死求生。
■唯美而惊悚的近未来日本
https://image.gcores.com/523a5c4dee4386c49aed826b7fe8ebd2-2048-1152.jpeg
https://image.gcores.com/9f5c35424994c6f517ad00f502100d4d-2048-1152.jpeg
探索以真实东京街区与地标为原型打造、唯美且诡谲的世界。穿梭于熟悉又陌生的街区，体验致敬早期3D游戏的独特低多边形美术风格。
■迎击妖怪
https://image.gcores.com/8215cbd1eddb17da540449ea256dfb73-1920-1080.png
https://image.gcores.com/23033d2bcd1525ebe5fe7b490009a0f4-2048-1152.jpeg
https://image.gcores.com/f53b20e4faf0649aef06473f1b9e0cf4-2048-1152.jpeg
名为“妖怪”的神秘变异体，其外貌令人联想到都市传说及日本民俗怪谈，但它们可不像普通鬼故事中的那么简单。部分妖怪会如野兽般凶猛扑击，另一些则会深思熟虑、默契配合，运用精密复杂的策略猎杀米莎。
■核心玩法
https://image.gcores.com/b9f2b2604faf06a26354afd08e71f4b8-2048-1152.jpeg
https://image.gcores.com/d97c19b464fbb0321b135e087b961ad3-2048-1152.jpeg
生存法则：巧用“离合”系统变换战术。为对抗妖怪，全体公安干员配备“模块化枪械”。枪械支持装配种类繁多的“武器模块”：从贯穿敌人并附加“眩晕”、“冰冻”状态的磁轨炮，到钉穿肉体施加持续伤害的射桩机，应有尽有。灵活运用枪械的“离合”指令，瞬间切换武器，释放狂风骤雨般的夺命连击。
https://image.gcores.com/e13f9cddb12a9fd20062f894cbeb8475-2048-1152.png
https://image.gcores.com/3bb8f41f14dddfec6c6d3869205b3115-2048-1152.jpeg
然而，胡乱扫射乃兵家大忌。无节制开火将积攒”热量槽“，最终导致过热爆炸，使你在数秒内沦为活靶子。唯有沉着冷静、操作精准，方能高效剿灭妖怪。
■无限改装可能
安装“武器程序”，深度改造枪械机能。无论是近战命中主动散热的控温程序，还是持续按住扳机加快步枪射速的强化程序，皆可随意选择。搭配海量程序，全方位定制你的模块化枪械，完美契合个人战术风格。
■战斗之余的片刻安宁
任务之外，米莎会在“墨田收复前哨站”休憩——这里是东京废墟中人类最后的堡垒。在前哨站内，米莎可以购买新武器模块、永久强化模块化枪械，还能在靶场精进射术。同时，她也能与朋友及同僚干员加深羁绊，并逐步揭开“妖怪危机”后世界的面貌。

现居石川县。自漫画杂志《Harta》（KADOKAWA）第85期起负责封面插画。创作轻小说封面插画，以及游戏、动画等的插画作品。目前在Coloso开设线上课程“将脑海中构想的画面完成为一幅插画的方法”。擅长描绘能让人感受到故事与世界观的情景。

items.title: IGN：GTA6主机版永远不可能60帧 PC没准可以
items.summary: IGN发文分析称，受主机硬件性能限制，尤其是处理器负载影响，《GTA6》永远不可能在主机平台上达到60帧的效果。

content.v: 随着Rockstar Games确认《GTA6》主机版以30帧为目标帧率，IGN发文分析称，受主机硬件性能限制，尤其是处理器负载影响，《GTA6》永远不可能在主机平台上达到60帧的效果。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/11/small_202611111010194237.png
IGN认为，PS5 Pro与基础版主机之间最明显的硬件差异在于GPU性能，因此Rockstar选择为PS5 Pro加入光线追踪阴影和PSSR超分辨率技术，以提升画面表现。但对于《GTA6》这类大型开放世界游戏而言，真正限制帧率的因素可能是CPU。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/11/small_202611111012237752.png
Rockstar此前曾表示，《GTA6》的地图规模超过工作室以往制作的任何作品，并将打造一个人口密集、内容复杂的游戏世界。游戏中的大量NPC都需要CPU进行模拟，而《GTA6》并非只需要处理单个场景中的人群。
玩家可以驾驶车辆高速穿越整个开放世界，游戏还必须动态加载新的角色和场景内容，这会进一步增加处理器负担。现世代主机使用的8核Zen 2架构CPU，可能难以在维持如此复杂世界运行的同时，将帧率提升至60帧。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/11/small_202611111012325346.png
此外，主机的CPU和GPU还需要共享统一内存池。《GTA6》既要处理NPC、天气等模拟数据，也要处理纹理、光照和角色模型等图形数据，内存资源同样可能成为限制因素。IGN认为，四款现世代主机都可能面临不同程度的性能瓶颈。
至于PC版本，IGN认为独立的系统内存与显存有望缓解部分资源竞争，而搭载高性能处理器、尤其是拥有大容量缓存的AMD X3D系列CPU，可能更有机会实现稳定的60帧。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/11/small_202611111012432457.png
不过，文章也提醒，即使是大多数游戏PC，运行《GTA6》时也未必能够轻松达到这一目标。

content.v: Haven Studios开发的劫掠射击游戏《 Fairgame $》已被取消，距离首次公布已过去三年多。部分自称参与后期测试的玩家随后分享体验，对游戏玩法和吸引力提出批评。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261111/1794362527_601373_jpg_r.jpg
一段以“Project Espresso”为名的测试者招募影像曾于9月流出，让外界首次较完整地看到游戏。此后进行的测试未能达到索尼为项目设定的目标。
ResetEra用户RedBullCola自称参加了后期测试，认为游戏整体表现不佳，比赛中的反馈同样负面，并将其形容为“一套高管创意组成的PPT”。Reddit用户Darkdhalias则称，游戏距离真正具备吸引力仍有多年，取消项目是正确决定。
另一名ResetEra用户srrai的评价相对温和。他认为游戏存在乐趣，但并不面向主流受众，可能难以获得足够的玩家和付费意愿，并表示自己或许愿意以40美元购买。上述说法均来自匿名社区用户，其身份及所体验的测试版本仍待核实。
索尼本世代积极布局服务型游戏，《绝地潜兵2》取得成功，但其他多项尝试进展不顺。Haven Studios员工据称不会因《Fairgame$》取消而失业，现阶段将转为支援其他PlayStation Studios作品。

content.v: https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261111/1794362156_553653_jpg_r.jpg
- 携手韩国国内外作曲家及来自世界各地的演唱者共同打造，专辑共收录42首曲目
- 融合多位音乐人的独特风格，进一步丰富音乐层次与整体规模
- 将韩国传统民谣及口传童谣重新演绎为西方风格的水手号子，打造独具特色的原创音乐
Pearl Abyss 正式发行《红色沙漠：增强版》第二张官方原声音乐专辑——《红色沙漠原声音乐 Vol.2》。

本次专辑共收录42首曲目，由Pearl Abyss首席音频总监Ryu Hwi-man、音乐总监Joo In-ro，以及韩国国内外作曲家和来自世界各地的演唱者共同参与制作。参与本次专辑的音乐人包括演唱者 Eivør、Colm R. McGuinness、Merethe Soltvedt，吉他手 Nathan Mills，以及布拉格大都会合唱团等。多位音乐人各具特色的艺术风格，为专辑注入了更加丰富的音乐层次与恢弘气势。
本次专辑进一步深化了游戏的戏剧性叙事，并呈现出优美动人的旋律。收录曲目涵盖抒情的场景主题曲、史诗级主题颂歌、战斗及Boss战主题曲，以及吟游诗人的歌曲等多种风格。此外，玩家还可以欣赏到充分展现帕卫尔大陆辽阔空间感的环境音景作品。
其中，将韩国传统民谣及口传童谣重新演绎为西方风格水手号子的曲目尤为引人注目。此次，布拉格大都会合唱团以西方水手特有的演唱节奏和英文集体合唱形式，重新诠释了《珍岛阿里郎》《乞丐打令》《青蛙啊，青蛙啊》《小朋友啊，小朋友啊》以及《木槿花开了》等韩国传统曲调。韩国独有的传统旋律与国际音乐人的艺术表现相互融合，最终打造出独具《红色沙漠》特色的原创音乐作品。
Pearl Abyss首席音频总监Ryu Hwi-man表示：“我们以韩国游戏开发商独有的原创性为基础，将韩国传统旋律重新演绎为正统的水手号子，让世界各地的玩家都能够毫无违和感地感受其中的乐趣与节奏感。”

content.v: 詹姆斯·古恩与彼得·萨夫兰离开DC Studios后，新负责人杰里米·拉切姆可能调整项目策略，优先推进更为大众熟悉的超级英雄。消息称，工作室将加快正义联盟核心角色登上大银幕的步伐，但是否全面重启DC宇宙仍未确定。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261111/1794361424_624451_jpg_r.jpg
消息称，Skydance首席执行官大卫·埃里森要求拉切姆尽快在大银幕上组建正义联盟。闪电侠、神奇女侠、蝙蝠侠及其他知名角色的项目预计将获得更高优先级，泥脸、金色先锋、和平使者等角色可能退居次要位置，超级少女也未被视为新策略下的首要项目。
这一方向与古恩偏爱开发非一线角色的做法形成对照。不过，古恩此前也曾表示，超人、蝙蝠侠和神奇女侠将成为DC宇宙的核心。两套策略的差别或许主要在推进速度，新管理层希望更快启动这些核心人物的项目。拉切姆预计也不会像古恩那样频繁通过社交媒体直接回应粉丝。
现行DCU启动时间不长，各项目尚未充分汇入统一叙事。在超人扮演者刚由亨利·卡维尔更换为大卫·科伦斯韦后，如果再次调整演员，可能给工作室带来声誉压力。目前，具体项目排序、演员安排及宇宙重启方案均未获DC Studios正式公布。

微软公布了一种让老款Xbox主机玩家体验《GTA6》的意外方式。根据Xbox Wire最新公告，《GTA6》将在11月19日发售当天支持Xbox云游戏服务，包括已经停产的上一代主机Xbox One。至于Xbox 360玩家，很遗憾，Xbox 360用户恐怕要失望了。

此前已经确认，《GTA6》不会推出原生Xbox One版本。微软将通过云端服务器运行游戏，再将画面串流到Xbox One上，让老款主机玩家无需购买Xbox Series X或Series S，也能探索游戏中的莱昂尼达州。不过，所有云游戏会话都将采用Xbox Series S的画面设置，无论玩家使用哪款设备。目前微软尚未公布具体画面表现，但玩家最好不要抱有太高期待。毕竟，《GTA6》在所有主机上都被限制在30FPS运行，即使是PS5 Pro也不例外。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261111/1794360917_500130.jpg
遗憾的是，PC玩家这次又一次成了被冷落的一方。

微软将《GTA6》的云游戏串流限制在Xbox主机上，这意味着Windows PC、智能手机、智能电视以及网页浏览器等平台，在游戏发售时都无法通过云游戏体验它。尤其令人不解的是，Xbox云游戏本身早已支持这些设备运行其他游戏。既然游戏是在微软的云端服务器上运行，理论上Xbox One能够访问的内容，Windows PC也没有理由无法访问。不过，考虑到这款游戏是《GTA6》，似乎也不能完全按照常规情况来理解。
这一决定实际上堵住了PC玩家在游戏发售初期体验《GTA6》的少数潜在途径。当然，目前可能已经有人正在研究那庞大的212GB游戏文件，说不定用不了多久，就会有人借助AI编程工具制作出非官方PC移植版本。当然，玩家也可以选择再等几个月，等待官方PC版本推出。据称，PC版的到来时间可能会比最初预期更早。
此外，《GTA6》不会加入Xbox Game Pass，玩家仍然需要单独购买游戏。与此同时，微软还将对Game Pass各档订阅服务引入每月云游戏时长限制。其中，Essential档每月仅提供5小时云游戏时间，Premium档为10小时，而价格最高的Ultimate档也只有15小时。
如果每月提供的游戏时间全部用完，玩家就只能额外购买云游戏时长，或者等待下个月额度重置。对于没有订阅Game Pass的用户，微软也将推出独立的云游戏时长套餐。在此前的Insider预览测试中，微软提供了三种选择：3.99美元购买10小时、7.99美元购买25小时，以及11.99美元购买50小时。不过，最终价格和供应情况可能因地区而异。
考虑到《GTA6》庞大的游戏规模，这些每月云游戏时长恐怕很快就会消耗殆尽。Xbox One玩家虽然能够省下一笔购买新主机的费用，但如果打算从头到尾通过云游戏体验《GTA6》，就必须提前考虑额外的时间成本和费用。

content.v: GamingBolt从战斗、装备、敌人、关卡、故事和呈现等方面比较了《 影之刃零 》与《鬼武者：剑之道》。文章最终明显偏向《影之刃零》，同时认为两作在战斗压力、叙事和视听呈现等方面各有优势。

items.title: Steam 在澳大利亚的年龄验证现在会考虑您帐户的年龄
items.summary: If your Steam account is at least nine years old, you should be good. Maybe.

content.v: In compliance with local laws, Steam rolled out age verification in Australia two months ago. Controversially, it was based on whether you owned a credit card, which many Australians do not. Overnight, Australians stopped being able to see games that are rated R18+ in the Steam store, like Doom, if they didn't have a credit card linked to their account.

Just as suddenly, Steam support has now updated how age verification works for Australians. Adding a credit card to your account still works, but additionally: "Steam will automatically consider your account age verified if it is at least nine years old and has had a consistent email address or billing information."

If you've moved house in the last nine years and let Steam know about it then your billing information won't have been consistent, so I sure hope you haven't changed both your email and physical address in that time.

Valve notes that it is aware this solution still isn't ideal for everyone: "We understand that not all Australians will be able to verify their age using our existing options. We are looking into other ways to comply with Australia's age verification rules while also limiting the data we collect and store from users."

Other storefronts provide alternative options like ID scans and face scans via digital age assurer Yoti. The Microsoft Store also takes your email account into consideration, via VerifyMy, the same assurer YouTube uses.

content.v: 包括 Sam Barlow 与 Austin Walker 在内的19名2027年独立游戏节 IGF 评委联合于日前发表声明，宣布拒绝为任何使用生成式 AI 制作的游戏投票。这些评委呼吁 IGF 能够制定严格政策，全面禁止包含 AI 生成内容的作品参选。
https://image.gcores.com/add0b3345b3c556decd06a15195524c9-724-400.png
根据这些评委的说法，做出这一决定是为了声援对行业前景感到担忧的创作者。他们认为，生成式 AI 会在生态、经济、认知及劳动权益等多个层面带来负面影响，这种伤害涵盖图像、音效、代码等所有环节。不仅用于训练模型的历史作品没有获得原作者授权，包括编程劳动在内的所有工作也应当得到同等尊重。这些评委更是表示，有其他评委出于职业风险等方面的顾虑而没有参与联署。
https://image.gcores.com/ab1ab4810da8ebfef393b14cc476cd79-1200-675.jpg
随着事件发酵，House House 工作室开发的《Big Walk》也确认成为了他们的抵制对象。House House 则回应称，项目后期曾使用 LLM 解决性能问题，但仅限于辅助技术排查。AI 生成的内容占游戏总代码不到 0.1%，其他创作环节均未使用。
开发团队同时表示，支持限制生成式 AI 危害的努力，也承认此前没有建立内部规范是自己的失误。由于V社豁免了 AI 辅助编码等用途的披露，《Big Walk》的商店页面确实没有相关说明。鉴于这些评委决定抵制任何有 AI 参与的游戏，这款广受好评的作品很可能也将无缘 IGF。

据Twisted Voxel援引彭博社记者Jason Schreier的报道，索尼已取消在Haven Studios开发数年的多人射击游戏《Fairgames》。这一决定出现在近期一次涉及数千名玩家的测试之后，测试结果未能达到PlayStation的预期。
报道称，PlayStation一位发言人向彭博社确认，此次取消不会导致这家位于蒙特利尔的工作室裁员，Haven Studios将转为支援索尼内部其他开发团队。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/11/cas_auto/small_0_9389902.jpg
据内部邮件，高管Sean Decker和John Doyle在周二发给员工的信中表示，开发团队在实时运营准备和社区互动等运营层面表现扎实，但实际游戏体验与玩家留存的结果不够理想，玩家反馈和留存“好坏参半，且未达到”公司目标。邮件还把竞争性PvP射击市场的挑战列为取消的另一因素，并写道“我们做出了停止开发这款游戏的艰难决定”。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/11/cas_auto/small_0_9389905.jpg
《Fairgames》是Haven Studios的首个项目，面向PS5和PC开发，原本被纳入索尼对服务型游戏的更广泛投入。游戏设定围绕一支针对超级富豪的地下团队展开，玩家潜入戒备森严的地点窃取货物，并与试图完成同一劫案的对手团队竞争。

报道还提到，项目在过去三年里经过多次重做，工作室曾准备以另一个名称重新公开，最终等来的是取消决定。对关注索尼第一方阵容的主机和射击玩家来说，这意味着又一款已公布多年的多人项目止步于测试阶段；Haven Studios的去向则从独立开发转为支援角色。

items.title: 一位《上古卷轴》粉丝正在复兴并升级（用人工智能）诺基亚 N-Gage 的一款失传的衍生产品，并将其移植到 PC 上
items.summary: Anyone remember Shadowkey?

content.v: I spend way too much time on wikis reading about spin-off games made for handheld and mobile devices I will probably never play (there was a whole trilogy of Silent Hill: Orphan games that have lived up to their name by being orphaned on old phones). The Elder Scrolls Travels are a prime example—games made in the gap between Morrowind and Oblivion. The third in the series, Shadowkey, came out on Nokia's N-Gage handheld—a cross between a GameBoy Advance and a mobile phone that lasted two years before being discontinued in 2005.

This first-person RPG is about to return thanks to Dan Whelan, whose Shadowkey Reforged project will let us play Shadowkey in widescreen with controller support and upscaled graphics. You can choose to play in classic or modern mode, but you can also toggle individual features one by one. Modern mode isn't just a graphical upgrade as it also adds features from the later mainline Elder Scrolls games like stamina-based sprinting, stealth, and ragdoll physics.

This is one of those times where I prefer the original game's look, as the brutally abrupt draw distance leaves a lot to your imagination while the modernized version seems to show enemies looming unresponsively in the near distance. And it's not like the upscaled character models actually look good, despite being beyond what Nokia's taco phone was capable of displaying.

While Shadowkey was never particularly well-ranked in the pantheon of Elder Scrolls games, people did praise its use of the Morrowind soundtrack, which Shadowkey Reforged will continue. Point it to your Morrowind install and it'll borrow both music and sound effects from the best Elder Scrolls game.

To answer the obvious question, Whelan says in the FAQ: "I used AI to assist with coding and building the engine, and with debugging. I used AI image generation combined with Photoshop and some manual sprite editing to create most of the modern, higher resolution artwork."

Whelan plans to release Shadowkey Reforged on November 11, which is just 18 hours away at the time of writing. You'll be able to download Windows, Mac, and Android versions from the website , though you'll need the original game's files from your Nokia N-Gage as well, or whatever abandonware site you frequent.

items.summary: Fairgames was revealed in 2023, but nothing more was ever seen of it.

content.v: A Bloomberg report says Fairgames, a PvP heist shooter announced by Haven Studios and Sony in 2023 , has been cancelled. In something of a surprising twist, a PlayStation rep told the site there will be no layoffs as a result of the cancellation, as Haven will "shift its focus to collaborating with other development teams across PlayStation Studios, while also exploring new creative opportunities."

While it was announced three years ago, work on Fairgames appears to have started even further back, in 2021. Just a couple months after her high-profile split with Google Stadia , Assassin's Creed co-creator Jade Raymond announced the formation of Haven Studios , which was "working on an unannounced new IP for PlayStation."

In 2022, right around the time former PlayStation boss Jim Ryan was talking about launching 12 live service games by 2025, Sony acquired the studio outright; a year after that, Fairplay was revealed to the world.

But things have not gone smoothly since then. Helldivers 2 was a massive hit, but seven of those planned games were cancelled before release . Of the remaining games, one was Marathon , which endures but has not lived up to expectations, and another was Concord , one of the most famously disastrous game launches in years, which was taken offline less than two weeks after it launched, never to return. A live-service spinoff of the Horizon series, Hunters Gathering, was also reportedly rebooted after negative feedback from playtests .
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PUBoF9fDoVjXdoKxkPVHhJ.jpg
Sony's live service graveyard
A partial accounting of canned multiplayer projects:

The Concord catastrophe in particular seemed to shake Sony, which began reversing its live service strategy just a few months later. Fairgames itself looked to be in trouble in 2025 when Raymond departed Haven , reportedly after an external playtest left PlayStation leadership "concerned about how the game was received and its progress."

The Bloomberg report says a more recent large-scale playtest produced similar results. "While the test demonstrated strong operational excellence, live ops readiness and community engagement, player feedback and retention results were mixed and fell short of the goals we had set,” PlayStation executives Sean Decker and John Doyle wrote in an email sent to Haven Studios employees. "Combined with challenging market conditions in the PVP shooter genre, we have made the difficult decision to cease development on the game."

The one bright spot to the cancellation is that no jobs will be cut because of it: A Sony rep told Bloomberg that Haven "will shift its focus to collaborating with other development teams across PlayStation Studios, while also exploring new creative opportunities."

神奇宝贝开心乐园餐正式回归，如果从我所在的当地麦当劳餐厅里的一大群青少年来看的话，他们比以往任何时候都多。
几周前，神奇宝贝公司首次宣布回归麦当劳促销活动，无意中破坏了明年的促销卡名单​​，引起了一些混乱。美好时光。
现在我已经拿到了 30 周年开心乐园餐，我可以确认之前泄露的卡组实际上是准确的，以及有关促销活动推出的新细节。
神奇宝贝开心乐园餐有麦当劳传统开心乐园餐的所有变种：汉堡包、芝士汉堡或 4 块和 6 块金块组合。价格根据您的餐食选择而有所不同，但每种选择都配有相同的包装和盲盒玩具。
我惊讶地发现，我当地的麦当劳似乎很少对这种合作进行营销，这可能因地点而异。我的麦当劳只有一张海报，并且在数字点餐屏幕上偶尔会闪现神奇宝贝开心乐园餐的预告片。
作为参考，当我去塔吉特的神奇宝贝发布会时，整个商店都被神奇宝贝材料覆盖了。许多海报和展位最终都出现在 eBay 上，因此 TPC 现在可能正在限制其“实体”营销足迹，以帮助商店避免任何争斗或犯罪。

While some social media users are claiming their local McDonald’s is approaching the collab as a progressive roll-out, my local D.C. McDonald’s had all three boxes and 15 promo cards ready to go. A staff member, however, did acknowledge that other stores may be receiving the promotional materials "in batches."

Given the swarms of kids and teenagers who had seemingly abandoned school for Pokémon, I was only willing to pick up two Happy Meals. (A six-nugget and a cheeseburger, in case you were curious.) The working manager was kind enough to ensure I got two different Pokémon boxes, which ended up being Torchic and Pikachu.
I quickly realized that was a strategic choice — almost every other customer was specifically requesting (and getting) the Umbreon box, so the staff was trying to manage its stock.

Of course, one of the main draws of the collaboration is new promo cards, which often end up reselling at the same price as the Happy Meal itself. While rumors had already been circulating online, I was still shocked to discover they really do give you the two promo cards without any packaging. They’re slipped into a box right next to a hard plastic toy that, for whatever reason, does get delicate tissue paper wrapping. The box, at least, is definitely serviceable for storing decks.
我承认缺乏包装确实让卡片显得不那么高潮，我可以想象已经有人抱怨卡片损坏了。尽管如此，我并不介意 Pokemon 稍微随意地对待它的促销卡，以便将 TCG 推广为一种游戏，而不是收藏者的球拍。
我反高潮地从第一个盒子里取出了伊布和暴君，然后在第二个盒子里找到了索罗亚克和水晶灯。每张卡片都是重印版，标有 M26 标签和自己的编号系统，有些卡片还带有全息箔。您可以在此处查看 2026 年促销卡的（真实）完整列表。
您获得的另一个玩具是开心乐园餐盒的微型塑料版本，其主题是单个神奇宝贝，完整的石板如下所示。每个玩具盒都有一个夹子，你可以用它把它固定在包或钥匙扣上，我碰巧得到了 Digilit 和好皮卡丘。
这远不是《神奇宝贝》第一次与快餐巨头合作。这种合作关系可以追溯到 1999 年，当时 Pokémania 首次大踏步发展。现代版“精灵宝可梦开心乐园餐”于 2011 年首次推出。
在《精灵宝可梦》诞生 30 周年之际，这项促销活动自然而然地回归，我认为这为粉丝们提供了参与庆祝活动的最佳预算友好方式之一。可以肯定地说，我很满意，尽管仍然很饿。

The Pokémon Happy Meal is now available across all U.S. McDonald’s locations through December 14. The promotion will be expanding to additional countries over the next couple of months, with the full roll-out detailed in an official McDonald’s post .

items.title: Capcom quietly updates the Monster Hunter Wilds beta listing on Steam, indicating a possible expansion playtest
items.summary: We might get an early taste of Ascendance before long.

content.v: Capcom still hasn't announced a release date for Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance, the Sunbreak-scale DLC that was revealed in February , but it seems like we might be getting a chance to sample the expansion before too long. A recent Steam listing update has provided a strong reason to suspect that there'll be a public beta for Ascendance available ahead of its launch in 2027.

As SteamDB changelogs show, the Steam app entry for Monster Hunter Wilds' 2024 public beta was quietly updated early this morning to change the app's name from "Monster Hunter Wilds Beta test" to "Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance Beta test." Similarly, the listing's visual assets were updated to feature key art of a hunter facing an Arateka, one of the new monsters being introduced in the expansion.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/LZY38HQzgRvaoiVLhDveNa-1920-80.png

And sure enough, while the Wilds beta was removed from player libraries after it ended, it's possible for users who'd previously played it to confirm its listing changes within the Steam app by viewing their own played games from their Steam profile. I just looked. It says Ascendance right there.

As the previous Wilds beta consisted of a repackaged demo build, it's likely that an Ascendance beta would follow suit: I'd expect a similar set of hunts to what in-person attendees were able to get hands-on time with at Tokyo Game Show in September, offering a chance to try out the new Boost Bracer weapon mechanics in Master Rank combat.

If a beta does materialize, it'll hopefully be a smoother experience than what beta hunters got in 2024. The early Wilds playtest was the first time PC players encountered the dreaded origami monsters , a symptom of the severe optimization issues that tanked Wilds' reputation for over a year after launch.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/6x7nyQDSrXxHrQRwKQKUK4-1920-80.jpg

As for when that beta might be available, we can only speculate—but given that Monster Hunter has made prior appearances at Geoff Keighley productions, a public playtest that accompanies a hypothetical Game Awards trailer makes intuitive sense. But I'm just reading the tea leaves here—Capcom hasn't said a word about when it'll offer its next DLC teaser.
Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance is set to launch some time in 2027.

items.title: 我们询问了美国任天堂公司的内特·比尔多夫 (Nate Bihldorff) 关于《时之笛》最不为人知的秘密的本地化事宜
items.summary: "The localization team, absolutely, puts the most importance on those single lines that are really, really har

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/03/zelda-how-long-1793730658114.jpg

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is filled with little pieces of dialogue tucked away in secret moments. You can trigger them by talking to a character at a very specific point in time, getting an item out of order and seeing how characters react, and various other ways. There are dozens of interactions that are really easy to miss: I’m on my third playthrough of the remake and am still stumbling into lines of dialogue I didn’t see the first two times around. During a launch event at Nintendo’s New York retail store, I spoke with Nate Bihldorff, Senior Vice President of Product Development and Publishing at Nintendo of America, and asked about how the localization team approaches these small moments.

“My group handles the localization of these games," Bihldorff said. "And I can tell you that the localization team, absolutely, puts the most importance on those single lines that are really, really hard to find. And you know, of course, they are murder on testing teams because finding that specific line and making sure that it appears correctly in the game is super important… But there was always something special about localizing those lines and knowing that only a few people were going to read it, that it took a specific course of action to get there, whether it's in a Zelda game like this or you’re sequence breaking in a Metroid game.

"Knowing that the person who's experiencing that line did something special to get it and wanting to make sure that it had that little extra oomph, I guarantee you the localization team would love to hear you say exactly that… You feel like you're connecting with the developers in those moments. It's a direct line where they're kind of winking at you.”

With so many secrets that exist just for the joy of being secrets, I can’t help but wonder if there are things in Ocarina of Time that no one has found yet. While Bihldorff is quick to point out that he can’t speak on behalf of the developers, he personally likes to think there’s still something hiding in Ocarina of Time that’s a secret to everybody.

“I like to believe that there are. Of course, that's a question for the developers. They probably would be very cagey in the way that they answered it. But I also feel like Nintendo games in general have a wondrous way of having something that you just don't discover forever.”

Part of the reason Zelda series producer Eiji Aonuma wanted to develop a remake of Ocarina of Time was so younger developers at Nintendo could familiarize themselves with one of the company’s most influential games. Developers with different levels of experience with the original Ocarina of Time came together to create its Switch 2 remake. Across the Pacific Ocean, the localization team at Nintendo of America had a similar experience.

“As someone who was also around for the original, I feel like it was almost doubly meaningful because you really feel the opportunity to not only be a part of something that was so meaningful for a previous generation of fans, but also be there at the moment that a new generation who had never played it before are going to experience it in really this unbelievably beautiful and well thought-out state.”

Internally at Nintendo of America, Bihldorff said that mix of generations led to different perspectives during localization: “You get to talk to somebody who maybe worked on the original game, and the IP has a specific meaning for [them], and then, a younger staff who's maybe coming in right out of school in their early 20s who, of course they've heard of it, but I'm seeing them experiencing these things for the first time… That sort of estuary water mix I think is something that's really, really important for the creative process, and it keeps this company vibrant. It's certainly something that I feed off of.”

The sense of anticipation was obvious as Nintendo employees prepared for the midnight launch while fans lined up outside. Nintendo of America is a very secretive place, and I’m always curious to learn what the process is like when they first get word of what the developers in Japan are working on years before a public event like this.

“I think it's not me pulling the curtain too far back to be able to say that every single one of these games is met with tremendous enthusiasm the second we hear about them. It’s a tough job sometimes, being behind the scenes when you can't talk to anybody. We don't talk to our spouses and stuff like that about it. It's a lot of secret stuff. And yet we're also passionate about the work and, of course, making sure that we bring the developers’ visions to market in a way that makes it proud. Everybody takes it very seriously, but they're also huge fans. So yeah, I can say, absolute excitement when we heard about this.”

After years of working in secrecy, Nintendo now hands Ocarina of Time off to the fans. One such fan at the launch event was Grammy, Oscar, and Emmy-winning musician Jon Batiste, who spoke to me about how The Legend of Zelda’s music influenced him from a young age, starting with Link’s Awakening on the Game Boy.

“When I was a kid and my sister, who was really my hero, she had a Game Boy and we would play. Every day, we rode up and down the street and she would play first, and then when the battery was almost out, she would give it to me and I would play until the battery ran completely out," Batiste said. "And I realized at that point, okay, I'm pretty much going to be doing this for the rest of my life.

“And then when I started to play Nintendo 64, that's when I started with Ocarina of Time and the music captured me. And I started to actually play those scores on instruments. And I played tons of scores from Nintendo games on the piano. My cousin and I actually, we have a video of us as a band when we first started playing, and our repertoire was probably 50% Nintendo franchise themes. So then we started to research who were the composers of the scores and we started to really pick favorites, like Koji Kondo. The sound of those melodies, I would say, was an early compositional influence.”

For more on The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, check out my interview with producers Eiji Aonuma and Hidemaro Fujibayashi . And, read about the launch event on the other coast, where Ryan McCaffrey spoke to Nintendo of America’s Bill Trinen .

items.title: 任天堂开设新职位以保存和整理其旧游戏
items.summary: Nintendo of America has opened up a new job position to help preserve and archive the older games in its vast

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/10/nintendo-hiring-archivist-to-organize-old-games-1794347962870.jpg
Nintendo of America has opened up a new job position to help preserve and archive the older games in its vast library.
Nintendo has released around 11,000 games in its lifetime. Now, it’s looking to organize those games — at least, the older ones — with a specialized role at its Redmond, WA location.

As per the official job description , Nintendo of America’s future Digital Archivist, Historical Systems will support the “preservation, organization, and accessibility of historical hardware and software information” by designing and implementing a “structured framework for organizing technical records, engineering documentation, source materials, and institutional knowledge related to legacy systems and platforms.”

Essentially, the digital archivist is a librarian of sorts, whose job is to create a means of organizing and documenting all of Nintendo’s older games, systems, and platforms, as well as any documentation or materials related to them. It definitely sounds like a fun role for video game history buffs, especially if they like organizing data.

The job listing describes its ideal candidate as someone with “expertise in archives, metadata management, information architecture, and research” who will work “closely with subject matter experts across engineering, product development, legal, and business teams” to “establish standards and processes that ensure historical information remains discoverable, usable, and preserved for future generations.”

The position is a 12-month contract role with a salary of $35-$55 per hour. A Bachelor’s degree in library & information science, Archives, Museum Studies, Information Management, History, Technical Communication, or a related field is preferred, although equivalent professional experience may be considered.

This is a major step forward for video game preservation, something that activists and enthusiasts in the space have been calling for for some time now. For example, the Video Game History Foundation was founded in 2016 with the intent of preserving and teaching the history of video games. Since then, it has worked toward creating the United States’ first dedicated library for the study of video game history, as well as preserving games’ source code.

Given Nintendo’s relevance in the games industry and its role in the history of the medium, it makes sense that the company would seek to archive its works. Perhaps this could result in some unexpected discoveries; for example, one collector came across 97 copies of an unreleased version of Super Mario Bros. Duck Hunt earlier this year, five of which were graded perfect 10s by PSA.

items.title: Pokémon TCG 的 Delta Reign Elite Trainer Box 已在沃尔玛和亚马逊降价至接近市场价
items.summary: Pokémon TCG Delta Reign Elite Trainer Box drops to $89.95 at Walmart, beating Amazon's new record-low $98.49 p

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/10/pokemon-tcgs-delta-reign-elite-trainer-box-almost-market-price-cover-1794329998641.jpg

It’s not even been a week since the Delta Reign hit the Pokémon TCG , but it already seems we’ve got a price war between retailers on our hands, meaning you can now get the nine-pack Elite Trainer Box almost at market price.

Since the Mega Evolution set’s latest expansion, we’ve surprisingly seen a sharp drop in estimated market values for particular products from the collection, despite there being plenty of expensive chase cards you can pull in Delta Reign . Walmart slipped under the $100 price for the ETB first, Amazon sellers caught up, and now the former has undercut competitors once again to be the cheapest of all.

Specifically, the Pokémon TCG: Delta Reign Elite Trainer Box can be found as little as $89.95 at Walmart , with free delivery currently set for November 12 (at the time of writing). To be clear, this lowest-price deal — with $50.04 taken off the current $139.99 list price — comes courtesy of third-party seller "Realgooddeal", but is still fulfilled by Walmart itself.

For comparison, Walmart’s new best price is $1.13 above its estimated $88.12 market price by dedicated trading card marketplace TCGplayer, with current legit listings going for a slightly higher $89.99 .

Keep in mind, however, that market price is an entirely separate metric compared to MSRP — but we have a dedicated guide explaining the difference if you’re unaware of the current stock issues in the Pokémon Trading Card Game’s market.

On the other hand, if you’re the type of Pokémon collector who only prefers to buy through Amazon, the Delta Reign ETB can be bought for as little as $98.49 at Amazon US through third-party seller “venado” — which is a new all-time low for the retailer, confirmed with price tracker camelcamelcamel .

Of course, no matter where you buy your new and sealed Delta Reign Elite Trainer Box from, the contents will be all the same: nine titular Pokémon TCG booster packs from the expansion, a full-art Kyogre promo card, 65 card sleeves, 40 Pokémon TCG Energy cards, a player’s expansion guide, six damage-counter dice, a competition-legal coin-flip, a plastic coin, and a code card for the Pokémon Trading Card Game Live app.
All of course come in a collector’s box, which works as its own storage, since six dividers to keep everything organised are also included.

content.v: 任天堂已推出Switch 2系统更新23.5.0。模组作者兼数据挖掘者OatmealDome表示，该版本修补了近期越狱方案利用的操作系统漏洞，游戏导出和模组修改能力因此再次受到限制。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261021/1792530242_648285_jpg_r.jpg
此前的方案以eShop提供的编程应用SmileBASIC 4为入口，属于需要持续保持软件运行的系留式越狱。设备一旦关机，用户就必须重新执行相关流程。尽管存在这一限制，使用者仍曾通过该方案导出Switch 2游戏及素材，并修改《马里奥赛车：世界》等游戏。
消息称，《塞尔达：时之笛 重制版》发售数小时后，便出现了从Switch 2版本导出并在PC运行的情况。OatmealDome称，安装23.5.0后已无法从游戏环境中“逃逸”，自制程序只能在游戏本身允许的范围内运行，游戏导出与修改也将再次变得不可行。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261111/1794347010_393205.png
不过OatmealDome认为，近期发行的部分实体卡带乃至某些更新可能不受影响。SwitchTools则判断，新实体游戏仍可能被导出，游戏钥匙卡也不受影响，但数字版游戏、更新和DLC的处理面临额外限制。
上述判断均来自第三方技术人员，补丁的实际覆盖范围仍有待进一步验证。部分用户表示，他们会拒绝安装此次更新，以便保留旧版系统中的漏洞。

items.title: Bungie 发布了 Marathon 的“合作 PvE roguelite”模式和时髦的新社交空间的游戏预告片
items.summary: The Symbiosis update, which will also kick off a beta for a new Team Deathmatch mode, will launch on December

content.v: Bungie has served up our first proper look at Marathon's big Symbiosis update , which is set to go live on December 8 with a permanent PvE mode, plus an all-new Team Deathmatch mode and a social space called Limbo.

Symbiosis represents the start of "the evolution of Marathon," Bungie said, with "a plethora of updates and changes" to the game. First and foremost is the addition of Marathon's PvE mode, now permanent and with a new name, Expedition, that's described in the teaser as a "co-op PvE roguelite." Details beyond that haven't been revealed just yet, but Bungie called it "phase one" of the team's PvE plan, suggesting that it remains a work in progress.

Also notable in Symbiosis is the addition of Limbo, a "social space" where players can hang out without getting aired out (although there does appear to be a little area set aside for friendly shootin'), and its firing range, a handy way to test the game's guns without having to venture into its less friendly locales.

Speaking of which, the Perimeter map is being expanded with new points of interest and tunnels, and a new sword-wielding runner shell, Bishop, will debut with the update. For those who prefer the PvP life, the update will also kick off a beta for Marathon's Team Deathmatch mode.

Overall, Symbiosis looks to be a pretty big deal, and while today's tease is light on detail, the early reaction among players on Reddit and social media seems quite positive. Bishop is already racking up fans:

One other bit of good news: The rollout of Symbiosis on December 8 will also mark the start of an "open play week," during which the game will be fully free to play, including the new modes and content. If you dig it and decide to stick around (ie., buy the game), any progress and items earned will carry over.

items.summary: World of Warcraft Forever has been incredibly popular, and has gone down as the biggest WoW launch in history.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/03/wowthumb-1793742518107.png

World of Warcraft Forever has been incredibly popular, and has gone down as the biggest WoW launch in history. It's little wonder, then, that some zones are absolutely packed with players — but thankfully, Blizzard has implemented a fix.

In a hotfix last night , Blizzard lowered the population in overcrowded zones, which should give players more of a chance to get quests done without competing with a hundred other players to tag a spider. In the developers' notes, Blizzard also noted that "We’ve made this an even bigger change on the PvP ruleset, following feedback from players that they felt overcrowded in several places. We will continue to monitor how zones feel and make further adjustments as necessary."

Unlike past versions of WoW, which had a variety of servers available, World of Warcraft Forever has one server that's divided into different rulesets: PvP, PvE, RPPvP, RP and Hardcore. Instead of dividing players among different servers, Blizzard uses layering to group people into different instances of the world. And because WoW Forever's whole thing is being surrounded by other players, Blizzard seemingly opted to try and get as many people into each layer as possible without causing problems.

However, while it's fun to see hundreds of players running around each zone, this approach has caused some issues. Some people on the PvE rulesets have reported difficulties in being able to finish quests, especially in the earlier zones, as they have to compete with dozens of different players to get anything done. But the problem is especially bad for players in the PvP rulesets because of a faction imbalance.

At least here in the US, The Horde is much more popular than The Alliance, and that's causing problems. For Alliance players, they're outnumbered when they're questing in the world, which means they get killed instantly in later zones. For Horde players, they can't create new toons, because Blizzard is throttling character creation to try and preserve faction balance.

Blizzard Community Manager Kaivax has addressed this in a seperate note last night , saying, "It’s vitally important that the PvP rulesets in WoW: Forever have balanced factions where both factions vie for supremacy, creating memories of epic victories and stunning defeats that we all remember for years to come. While even the most extreme case in a region is currently at roughly a 55/45 split, that is not as close as we want it to be." Blizzard wants to get that balance as close to 50/50 as possible.

To address the matter, Kaivax says, "In the short term, that means that it will become increasingly difficult to create characters on the more populous faction in each region – currently Horde on North American PvP rulesets or Alliance in EU Roleplay-PvP. As everyone settles and shifts, these may flip to the other side."

Despite some of these growing pains, though, World of Warcraft Forever is still proving to be one of the smoothest launches in Blizzard history. Launch night went off without a hitch , thanks to the servers running on around 251TB of RAM and over 70,000 CPU cores.

content.v: Skydance负责人David Ellison近日在公司财报电话会上谈及人工智能。他认为，AI可能成为现代史上最大的创意突破，对影视制作的影响甚至可能超过20世纪90年代CGI与特效技术带来的变化，但艺术家仍是创作中的关键角色。

items.summary: Sony has canceled the upcoming live-service shooter Fairgame$, but there will be no job cuts connected to the

content.v: Sony has canceled the upcoming live-service shooter Fairgame$, but there will be no job cuts connected to the game's closure. This is according to a report from Bloomberg today.

The game was in the works at Haven Studios in Montreal, a team founded by former Assassin's Creed veteran Jade Raymond. She left the studio back in 2023 , and Fairgame$ was delayed to 2026 at the time. Now the game is scrapped entirely.

According to the report, Haven "reworked" the Fairgame$ concept several times in the past three years. The studio was reportedly planning to re-reveal it with a new game. Going forward, Haven staff will support other PlayStation projects, the report said.
You can watch the original CGI reveal trailer for Fairgame$ below.
Fairgame$ was officially canceled following a playtest that didn't show strong results.

“While the test demonstrated strong operational excellence, live ops readiness and community engagement, player feedback and retention results were mixed and fell short of the goals we had set,” PlayStation executives Sean Decker and John Doyle said in a memo seen by Bloomberg. "Combined with challenging market conditions in the PVP shooter genre, we have made the difficult decision to cease development on the game.”

Creative director Mathieu Leduc said in a blog post that Haven was founded with the goal of making games that its staffers wanted to play, and that’s why the team chose a competitive multiplayer game.

“Fairgame$ came from a desire to create a new type of PvP game with emergent sandbox gameplay. We want to deliver a fresh multiplayer experience that rewards creativity and mastery and delivers surprising stories each and every time you play,” Leduc said.
“In a nutshell, this is a thrilling competitive heist game where you join an underground movement to rob the ultra-rich and rebalance the scales,” Leduc said.

As you can see in the announcement trailer, Fairgame$ has players going after billionaires who have “too much money and too much power.” In the trailer, we see a squad of players infiltrating some kind of compound, working together to take down security guards with the apparent aim of sticking it to the man.

“Fairgame$ will give you an opportunity to break the rules as a modern-day Robin Hood, a thrill seeker, or just someone who wants to collect cool loot,” Leduc said. “Trespass inside forbidden locations around the world, fill your pockets like a kid in a candy store and unravel the nefarious plans of untouchable billionaires.”

Back when Fairgame$ was announced in 2023, Sony was in the midst of a huge push and investment into the live-service market. At one point in time, Sony wanted to release 12 live-service games over the coming years (alongside its commitment to single-player games). However, in May 2023, Sony announced that it was halving its planned live-service game output , with management stressing it wanted to focus on quality over quantity. After this announcement, Naughty Dog’s The Last of Us multiplayer game was canceled in December 2023.

At the beginning of 2024, though, Sony found its biggest success to date in the live-service market with Helldivers 2–the game went on to smash sales records and become the No. 3 overall best-selling game of 2024 in the US.

In July 2024, Sony’s Destiny developer Bungie announced mass layoffs and major structural changes . A month later, Sony launched the multiplayer game Concord. It had such a dismal performance out of the gate that Sony quickly took the game offline and refunded all players . Its developer, Firewalk, was later closed.
At the end of 2024, Sony confirmed that it canceled multiple projects, including a live-service God of War and another live-service title from Bend.

It was reported in 2023 that PlayStation boss Jim Ryan, who left Sony in 2024, had a mandate that Sony’s teams should make more games-as-a-service titles . A number of PlayStation developers were reportedly upset with this, and the blame was said to have fallen not on Ryan but Connie Booth, one of the most important and veteran PlayStation developers, leading to her eventual departure.

Another former PlayStation boss, Shuhei Yoshida, said the chance of finding success in the competitive live-service market was “small,” but his replacement, Hermen Hulst, was given the resources to fund both single-player games and live-service titles at the same time. However, had Yoshida stayed in that role, he said he would have “tried to resist” the push into the live-service market. He joked, “That’s one of the reasons they removed me.”

《饥饿》以拿破仑时代的欧洲后末世废墟为背景，将第一人称射击、砍杀、角色扮演与恐怖元素完美结合，让你置身于惊心动魄的黑暗世界。作为幸存者中的一员，你可以独自踏上征途，也可组建二至三人的小队，穿梭于危机四伏之地，直面由这场瘟疫浩劫催生出的恐怖生物——Hunger。

找准你的定位
在残酷的后末世世界里，城堡中形形色色的居民，比如任务发布者、店铺老板、仓库管理员、赏金猎人等等，都将与你的命运紧密相连。通过完成挑战、累积声望，你将解锁新的区域、技能、角色、武器、装备以及生存资源。

你可用步枪或手枪射击，也可用实验型手炮投掷瓶装手雷。当弹药告罄或来不及装填子弹时，你可拔出斧头或狼牙棒，进行招招致命的贴身肉搏。《HUNGER》巧妙融合策略性远程热战与近战格斗。你将与Hunger，以及试图夺取你资源的其他幸存者展开殊死对决。你需要搜寻并装备好盔甲、背包、饰品、药物、武器和盾牌，为即将面临的多种环境及战斗做好准备。
进阶升级
你的大多装备与武器或将丢失，但所有经验值都可用于提升幸存者角色等级。每位幸存者均有一套可解锁的独特被动、战术和终极技能，以及100多项可灵活调整的天赋树供选择。悄声细步、撬锁开门，打造适于秘密行动与孤身作战的角色。加快换弹速度、提升武器掌控力，专精远程战斗。以牺牲个人武力为代价，换来修复队友盔甲、治愈同伴的能力。生存是成功的唯一标准。
探索瘟疫肆虐的土地
深入森林、村庄、修道院、城堡、矿山等地，你将与其他幸存者探索并搜刮后末世的遗迹。

items.summary: A new Grand Theft Auto 6 trailer debuted today, November 10, and the video showed off a race car driver doing

content.v: A new Grand Theft Auto 6 trailer debuted today, November 10, and the video showed off a race car driver doing a backflip. The animation looks smoooth .

That's notable because the Extended Look trailer that debuted back in August showed Jason doing a backflip and people online quickly roasted it for looking ... off. Other said it looked totally fine. Whatever the case, some are saying this new backflip animation being featured in the latest trailer is an example of Rockstar taking feedback seriously, but it could be more nuanced than that.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Screenshot-2026-11-10-at-3.05.31-PM.png

That's because it subsequently came to light that the backflip animation in GTA 6 is controlled by the player and isn't locked to one specific animation. However, we don't know who is doing the backflip in this newest clip.
If the character in the trailer is an NPC, as people on Reddit are surmising , then the animation could have been motion-captured as opposed to being player-controlled, hence why it looks less janky.

In any event, this backflip stuff becoming a "controversy," if you can even call it that, is yet another example of how ramped-up people are for GTA 6. People are so jazzed for the release that they are poring over even the smallest details, which you may never even notice when playing the game for yourself .

GTA 6 releases on November 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, and preloading is live now. The game unlocks at midnight local time on November 19, and that means people in the US will be among the last in the world to play .

items.title: Take-Two 首席执行官表示，在汽油和杂货价格上涨的情况下，GTA 6 的售价为 80 美元，非常“划算”
items.summary: It's no secret that life is expensive. Gas and grocery prices are up, in particular, and against that backdrop

content.v: It's no secret that life is expensive. Gas and grocery prices are up, in particular, and against that backdrop, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick believes GTA 6 at $80 is a "bargain" due to how many hours people can play it.

"I think the consumer is under pressure. these are challenging times. Inflation has hit average consumers. Food prices are up. Gas prices are way up, and it's taking a toll," he told CNBC . "I think we are going to see that as we head into the Christmas season undoubtedly. Entertainment is not immune to such forces."
What gives Zelnick hope in this environment is that, in his belief, "interactive entertainment is actually a real bargain," and particularly a game like GTA.

"There are so many hours of engagement on offer. Even a short video game is 10 hours of engagement on the low end. You can play Grand Theft Auto 5 for hundreds of hours and not get bored. We'll see how people feel about Grand Theft Auto 6, but I believe that you'll be able to engage for an extraordinary long period of time," he said. "So if consumers look at entertainment value as the intersection of how great it is and how long you can engage with it, interactive entertainment is a great bargain. However, when you give people what they want, no matter what the times are, they will show up for it."

GTA 6's base edition costs $80, while there is also a $100 Ultimate Edition featuring a variety of additional in-game content. GTA 5, meanwhile, launched at $60 in 2013; that same $60 is about $85 today after adjusting for inflation. This is a point that Zelnick has made repeatedly when explaining why GTA 6 is actually a very good value. He's also said Rockstar could have charged even more for GTA 6 , but chose not to so the game could reach more people.

While GTA 6's price is actually lower than what GTA 5 launched at in 2013 , the same cannot be said for the hardware people need to play it on. The PS5 and Xbox Series X|S consoles are more expensive than ever due to the ongoing global component and memory shortages. If you're OK streaming the game, Microsoft just announced a 10-year deal with Take-Two that includes bringing GTA 6 to Xbox Cloud Gaming on the older Xbox One console.
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and preloading is now underway.

content.v: Two years after the release of Unknown 9: Awakening , its one and only game, Bandai Namco's Reflector Entertainment is closing.

The shutdown was revealed in a notice posted by Banda Namco (via Game Informer ) saying the company "has passed a resolution to dissolve and liquidate its consolidated subsidiary Reflector Entertainment." The decision was made "after comprehensively considering future business plans, necessary additional investment, and the possibility of profitability and business continuation," Bandai Namco said.

Unknown 9: Awakening, featuring The Witcher star Anya Chalotra as a woman able to travel into a mysterious dimension known as the Fold, showed potential in our pre-release preview as a "linear, narrative-driven, set-piece laden" game drawing from Xbox 360 releases of the late 2000s.

The full game, however, landed with a thud. A month after launch, Reflector laid off 18% of its workforce ; a few months after that, in January 2025, more layoffs followed as an in-development project was cancelled . Reflector CEO Herve Hoerdt said at the time that the decision "correlates directly with the failure of the studio's ambitious and courageous first project [Unknown 9: Awakening]," which "didn't come near the company expectations."

Reflector confirmed the coming end of operations in its own message on LinkedIn , writing that "after reviewing the progress of our latest project in pre-production, future development requirements, and current market conditions, Bandai Namco concluded that it could not justify several more years of investment."
Bandai Namco said the liquidation of Reflector Entertainment is expected to happen "once the necessary procedures according to local laws are completed," but a concrete schedule has not been set.

November’s lineup of games on PlayStation Plus has been revealed by Sony.

Ahead of the holiday season, PlayStation Plus members are getting a wide variety of free games that they can try out on the service, including two big titles from Kojima Productions and Ryu Ga Gotoku.

The first game on this list is Death Stranding 2: On the Beach . The sequel to the first Death Stranding game, this follow-up takes eleven months after the events of its predecessor, featuring Sam Porter Bridges and Fragile as they set out across Australia to connect surviving colonies with the Chiral Network. It’s well worth a play, especially with this deal on PS Plus; in our review, IGN’s Simon Cardy scored the game a 9 out of 10 , calling it a “triumphant sequel that emphatically delivers on the promise of its original.”

Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii is the second game on this month’s list. Join an amnesiac Goro Majima after he wakes up stranded on an island, gather a crew of pirates, and uncover a hidden treasure in this spinoff of the Yakuza series. It’s a delightfully fun romp, and another title that’s well worth taking advantage of if you’re a PS Plus subscriber; IGN’s Tristan Ogilvie scored the game an 8 out of 10 in our review , calling it “a consistently captivating voyage that kept my timbers shivering whether on land or at sea.”

Other games included in this month’s PS Plus lineup are Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake , a reimagining of the beloved classic that earned a 9 out of 10 from our reviewer, as well as 2025 survival-action game Atomfall , first-person shooter Trepang2 , and racing game MotoGP 26 .

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/10/burgerkingmtg-1794335089331.jpg

Burger King just launched a Magic: The Gathering meal that comes with Whopper-themed deck boxes and sleeves. Unfortunately, the promotion is exclusive to Burger King Italy, with no indication that it will expand to other countries.

However, not all hope is lost for players from other regions — this is one of the first fast-food partnerships from Wizards of the Coast, following the trend of franchises like Pokémon . If the promotion goes well, it’s safe to expect more MTG collaborations across other regions in the future.

The Great Gathering Bundle (they use English on the official Burger King Italy site ) includes your choice of a Chicken Krispper, Double Cheeseburger, or the plant-based Impossible Whopper with fries and a drink. It’s priced at €19.90, equivalent to roughly $22 USD, and is available now through November 30.

That sounds yummy and all, but the real kicker that’s both intrigued and frustrated Magic fans is the new TCG accessories. Each meal comes with a Burger King-themed deck box and 100 card sleeves, perfect for your silliest Commander deck. Both accessories, which can be see in the image above, are designed in the style of a Whopper burger, with an orange ‘sesame bun’ pattern, a patty, and layers of toppings.

Sturdy deck boxes on their own are rarely under $20, making the accessories a genuinely good deal. As it stands, however, the only way to get your hands on them is by going to Italy to chow down on some Burger King.

Unlike the Pokémon Happy Meal , the MTG Burger King collaboration does not include any promotional cards. This could be a good thing, as region-locked cards can compound ongoing scalping concerns in an already tumultuous TCG market. Still, I wouldn’t be surprised if the Burger King deck boxes end up becoming a hot commodity on EBay.

Keen customers have already been sharing their spoils online, picking up some buzz from online MTG communities and the ire of fans from other countries. One X user who got their hands on the collab praises the quality of the deck box, but suggests the sleeves "feel a little flimsy and cheap."

items.title: GTA 6 在游戏机上永远不会达到 60 帧每秒
items.summary: Back when Rockstar showed off a bunch of GTA 6 gameplay on Netflix, one thing was incredibly clear – the game

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/09/ultimate-edition-electric-fang-03-1794260488819.jpg

Back when Rockstar showed off a bunch of GTA 6 gameplay on Netflix, one thing was incredibly clear: The game was running around 30fps. And now that Rockstar has confirmed that it is targeting 30fps on every console, including the PS5 Pro, it's clear that the game likely never would have run at a solid 60 on console.

In a blog post today, Rockstar finally shared some performance information, saying it was targeting 30fps on every console, with the PS5 Pro instead getting some extra ray tracing and PSSR to make it look better. While I'm sure there are plenty of people who would rather that effort go into a 'performance mode' that runs a bit faster, it might not have even been possible.

The biggest difference between all of the different levels of consoles, the Xbox Series S, the base PS5 and Xbox Series S, and the PS5 Pro is the strength of the GPU. That's why the PS5 Pro is getting ray tracing effects that the other consoles aren't. But, with an open world game like GTA 6, the limiting factor is probably the CPU.

Rockstar has already gone on record saying that the map in GTA 6 is bigger than any other game from the developer, and that, specifically, it's going to be densely populated. When we interviewed Rob Nelson , co-studio head of Rockstar North, he told us the team was "doing everything we possibly can to create the largest, deepest, most densely populated and complex world we have ever built for people to get lost in." And no matter how much trickery you can pull with a GPU, simulating an entire city full of NPCs is going to tax the CPU.

Just watching the Netflix extended trailer , and there are a lot of people in every scene, each of which needs to be simulated by the CPU. But, due to the nature of GTA, it's more than just individual scenes having a lot of people wandering around. This is an open world game, where you can get in a car and traverse the entire map at high speeds. The game needs to be able to account for this and load in new actors dynamically, and there's only so much you can do with an 8-core Zen 2 CPU at a 3.85GHz boost clock.

Remember, too, that on every current-gen console, the CPU and GPU share a unified memory pool. That really matters in a game like GTA 6 because that memory has to handle both simulation data like NPCs and detailed weather events, along with graphics data like textures, lighting and character meshes. No one outside of Rockstar has seen the performance metrics for this game, but I wouldn't be surprised if the game is running up against its limits on all four of the consoles.

As it stands, the only way you're going to be able to play this game at 60fps is to either wait for the PC version or the inevitable PS6 and Project Helix ports. But, I think even most gaming PCs are going to struggle to get a solid 60fps in this game.

If you look at the most recent Steam Hardware Survey, most people are on CPUs with 8-cores or less, which could run into some of the same limits as the console versions. The difference, though, is that most PCs have dedicated RAM and VRAM for their CPU and GPU, respectively, so there should be less of a bottleneck – especially if you're on a speedy X3D processor with all of that speedy cache available. At least it looks like I probably don't have to wait too long to see how GTA 6 is going to run on PC .

Only time will tell just how well GTA 6 is going to run on these consoles, and hopefully it stays locked at a solid 30fps most of the time. Rockstar probably chose its words very carefully when it said it was 'targeting' 30fps in its blog, so I'm very curious at how well the Xbox Series S is going to hold up. Now that we're just 9 days out from GTA 6's November 19 release date, we won't have to wait long to find out.

items.title: Valve 为您提供更多方法来了解游戏在 Steam Deck 上是否运行良好
items.summary: Valve's Steam Deck verification program has been a helpful, if somewhat flawed, method of determining if a gam

content.v: Valve's Steam Deck verification program has been a helpful, if somewhat flawed, method of determining if a game is a good fit for the company's handheld PC. But while many games might be granted a "Verified" badge, there have been many cases where real-world performance doesn't live up to the expectation of players. That's why Valve has introduced a more nuanced way for you to determine if a game is a good fit for the Steam Deck.

Along with the Steam Deck verification status, games will now feature average frame-rate data on the store page once Valve has gathered enough data from players. This will give you an indication of real-world performance on the Steam Deck, collecting data from other players using the Steam Deck in their default states and averaging it across their total playtime.

"The current Steam Deck Verified compatibility rating is based on standardized test criteria, but it may not match every customer’s bar for acceptable gameplay," the announcement post reads . "This is especially true around performance - a game with an Unsupported rating due to unstable performance may be considered playable by some customers, and a Verified game may not reach a framerate that some customers prefer to play at."

Alongside the average, Valve is also adding a histogram that let's you see numerous averages spread out over playtime. This can help you determine if a game has pockets of poor performance that might be dragging down the average, giving you even more information to help you determine if a purchase for Steam Deck play is worthwhile.

Valve relies on other players for this data. So while it says that thousands of games already have this featured on their store pages, there are still many more that require more playtime before they can be calculated and displayed. The data collection is opt-in, too, meaning only Steam users actively sharing their data through the Steam Beta Client will count towards these averages. Valve says it will be rolling out this program to the main Steam branch soon.

It also says that tools like this could come to other platforms in the future, but that it chose the Steam Deck first because of its standard hardware configuration. It's easy to see this being extended to the Steam Machine for the same reasons, with Valve potentially waiting for more of them to be in the hands of players before being able to accurately average the data. It's a useful metric that not only helps players make more informed buying decisions, but also potentially helps Valve determine what is, and isn't a meaningful jump in performance as it evaluates a potential Steam Deck successor .

items.title: 《魔兽世界》：《永远》刚刚迎来了发布后的第一个重大变化
items.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever received its first post-launch updates over the weekend, giving players a good reas

content.v: World of Warcraft: Forever received its first post-launch updates over the weekend, giving players a good reason to run each dungeon more than once alongside upcoming class tweaks.

On November 8, developer Blizzard issued a hotfix that increased kill experience while in dungeons by 50%. According to the forum post , Blizzard said this is so it "feels better to go back for more runs," and made reference to a Wailing Caverns dungeon quest to collect Deviate Hides that often requires more than one run.

It previously outlined upcoming class changes that will go live on November 10. Those changes will make it so Hunter and Warlock pets are sturdier, improve Affliction Warlock's damage-over-time spells, and make it so Enhancement Shamans will want to pursue strength and attack power items instead of intellect and spell power ones.

The debate on how much experience dungeons should grant in Forever has been an ongoing back and forth since the game's beta. Initially, dungeons were particularly lucrative, with massive experience rewards from dungeon quests.

That changed about halfway through the beta due to concerns that players were leveling too quickly while doing dungeons. Blizzard axed dungeon quest experience as a result. While dungeons were still worthwhile to do once thanks to potent item rewards, doing them multiple times proved to be less valuable. With no quests to do, kill experience earned in dungeons was lackluster.

Forever's launch on November 4 carried that philosophy forward, but it quickly became apparent dungeons were simply not worth doing after one quest-focused run. It was even more of an issue considering that many dungeons have item-collection quests that are difficult to complete in a single run when all five members of the group are trying to do it at once. However, because doing a dungeon a second time was so inefficient when it came to earning experience, going back in to try and complete that quest felt like a waste of time.

In an episode of the WoW: Forever podcast from October 8, Blizzard said it doesn't want dungeons to be a "one and done" experience while leveling, but also doesn't want them to be so rewarding that they become the most "efficient" way to level up. This latest tweak then seems to be Blizzard making good on that philosophy.

The class changes are smaller but still significant, particularly since Blizzard previously said not to expect major class changes prior to the arrival of Forever's endgame raids on December 9. They specifically address a key pain point for Enhancement Shamans, who have complained about their specialization's need for intellect and spell power gear despite being a melee-focused spec. Ahead of Forever's launch, the WoW Classic Shaman Discord shutdown in protest of the state of the class, and now Blizzard has made good on at least one of the Discord server's list of complaints.

Forever's launch went surprisingly smooth , despite being the biggest concurrent-player launch in WoW's 22-year history. On the eve of launch, Blizzard revealed Forever's first new legendary weapon , Taldramir, the Whispering Wood.

items.title: PlayStation Plus PC 应用程序将于 12 月关闭，因为只有不到 0.4% 的合格订阅者在使用它
items.summary: Yes, this fits with Sony's broader pullback from PC, but the real reason the app is "retiring" is a simple lac

content.v: Sony took another step back from the PC today, announcing that the PlayStation Plus app for PC will be "retiring" on December 10. I can't really blame it for this one, though: Almost nobody was actually using it.

"PlayStation believes in providing high-quality experiences to our players, and we regularly review offerings to ensure we are focusing on experiences our members value most," Sony wrote at the tail-end of a PlayStation Blog update detailing the PlayStation Plus game lineup for November.

"With a very small number of eligible PlayStation Plus Premium members (less than 0.4%) using the PlayStation Plus app on PC, making this change allows us to focus on enhancing high-quality experiences that more of our members want to use. As a result, the PlayStation Plus cloud streaming app on PC will no longer be available."

The end of the app seems to fit pretty well with Sony's recent about-face on PC gaming: After a brief period of enthusiasm for bringing its big exclusives to PC, Sony began a walkback earlier this year, shifting its focus back to consoles exclusives. It hasn't explicitly acknowledged or explained the change in strategy, but as PC Gamer's Morgan Park wrote in May , the thing speaks for itself: Rather like Xbox "recommitting" to its console, "Sony is responding to a waning interest in consoles by reinforcing its 'narrative singleplayer games' as system sellers once again.

"Multiplayer games like the upcoming Marvel Tōkon will still come to PC, but if you want to play the next prestige action game from the likes of Naughty Dog or Insomniac, you'll need a PS5," Morgan wrote. Or, when the time comes, a PlayStation 6 .

Similar to Xbox cloud streaming, the PlayStation Plus app on PC was really more noteworthy for the selection of older PlayStation games it offered to PC gamers, rather than major new releases. Given that, I think the end has come for exactly the reason Sony cited: Not due to any strategic realignment, but simply because nobody's using it in the first place.

items.title: 我安装了一个 GTA 5 mod，它让人类下雨了，不，我也不知道为什么
items.summary: It's raining men. And others.

content.v: I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .

Bring Up The Bodies, often regarded as Hilary Mantel's masterpiece (more of a Place Of Greater Safety man myself), opens thus: "His children are falling from the sky. He watches from horse-back, acres of England stretching behind him; they drop, gilt-winged, each with a blood-filled gaze".

This is a description of Thomas Cromwell's falcons in 1535. It is also a description of the life of Franklin Clinton in 2026. Los Santos is awash in bodies because I have installed PeopleFalling – BloodSky , a mod which sends an endless wave of people plummeting to Earth like a horrible hard rain. "A modification called 'People Falling' or as I call it, 'Blood Sky'", writes the author, confusingly, as they presumably chose both names.

"When you press the 'X' key, characters drop from the sky. You can change the activation button in the .ini file". This is a lie. It's actually the B key. My relationship with PeopleFalling AKA BloodSky got off to a rocky start.

It does work though. Sort of. Tap B (not X) and the rainy season begins—people fall silently to the ground in a kind of reverse-Rapture situation, absolutely all of them physics-free and adopting the same stomach-sleeper position when they finally make contact with sidewalk, with highway, with rooftop.

Then it ends, and no matter how much you tap B—notifications reading "Falling people Active" and "Falling People Deactive" flashing in the lower right of your screen—they never come back. It's like you have witnessed a beautiful, once-in-a-lifetime miracle, like a full solar eclipse or Halley's comet.
Also, when the process is ongoing it really alarms my bodyguard, who responds like a dog hearing a bang in the house at night.

items.summary: Logitech has announced that it will be giving employees the option to take time off for video game releases ah

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/03/mnhvfjvxktyweecyny4xem-2560-80-jpg-1793719537543.webp
Logitech has announced that it will be giving employees the option to take time off for video game releases ahead of GTA 6's launch.

The tech company announced that it will label this perk as "Logi Game Day" for its employees. Logitech explained that this idea came about from an internal study, which concluded that "81% of gamers believe that gaming builds real-world confidence, reduces anxiety, and correlates with stronger day-to-day work performance." Another study noted that 98.8% of enterprise ITDM respondents believe that gaming translates to actual workplace skills, such as problem-solving and acting under pressure.
As a result, the company is going to lean into that and give people the freedom to take time off to play new video games.

“It’s time to retire the stereotype that gaming is a waste of time,” said Hanneke Faber, Logitech’s chief executive officer. “As a company designing products for work and play, we see every day how engagement in one sphere supports performance in the other.”

On November 19, Logitech G, the company's gaming division, will host a live-streamed event at its San Jose headquarters to celebrate the occasion. This, likely coincidentally, aligns with the release day of GTA 6. It's unclear exactly what the event will feature, but it will be hosted by Logitech G’s general manager, Robin Piispannen.

“Whether diving into a game like GTA 6 or Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4, shaving seconds off lap times in Forza, or teaming up in an online battle, Game Day gives our team a shared purpose," he says. “We see firsthand how Logitech employees who sharpen their skills in-game translate directly back to work & problem solving.”

GTA 6 is officially almost a week away from launch, and fans can officially preload the massive game starting today . Millions of people are expected to take the game's launch day off, and some countries are even advertising ways for people to do so . It's expected to be one of the biggest cultural events of the decade, if not the century. Rockstar hasn't revealed GTA 6's preorder data so far, but its parent company, Take-Two Interactive, has confirmed that they're "far in excess" of their expectations .

items.title: Bungie 以免费时段吸引新玩家，PvE 模式和 PvP 竞技场战斗来到马拉松
items.summary: PvE is coming to Marathon and Bungie is hoping new players will give it a shot with a free-to-play period at t

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/24/marathonthumb-1790271185101.png
PvE is coming to Marathon and Bungie is hoping new players will give it a shot with a free-to-play period at the start of the next Season. It’s called Symbiosis and is landing on December 8.

One of the big new changes is an update to Perimeter, giving the early game region a much-needed shake up. Previously, there was no in-between on the map, with matches either a constant meat grinder against other players or completely dead.

The zone update sees the playable zone expanded as alien trees sprout from the landscape. Now there are dark caves leading to a new POI called Reservoir, which features a large main room and catwalks for nasty ambushes. Oh, and there’s a giant crab boss now.

If you bounced off Marathon because of those aforementioned ambushes, Bungie is introducing a new mode just for you: PvE Expeditions. These let you test yourself against the tougher challenges Marathon has to offer (like big crabs) without the added threat of a team murdering you and stealing your stuff as soon as you pull it off.

Rather than taking the Arc Raiders approach and letting players play the normal extraction loop without the threat of other players, it’s seemingly a standalone mode Bungie is calling a “co-op PvE roguelite.” That means metaprogression, in-match upgrades, no two matches the same. From Bungie, it should be good stuff.

The upgrades in the new mode are called Flash Boosts and should let you become a god in an entirely new way each run. Challenges escalate with each layer you break through and scale with your power. Check out the trailer:
Bungie also introduces a new social space for Symbiosis. It’s called Limbo, and it’ll let you hang with your friends and test out kits.
It should be a good place to train with Bishop, the game’s new high-jumping and sword-slashing new Runner Shell. The trailer shows Bishop cutting through a whole gang of bots with his Ultimate.

On top of all this, there are new weapons and gadgets, as well as a new PvP deathmatch mode for people who want to get better at not being murdered in the normal extraction loop. Marathon will be free December 8-15, giving new players a chance to check it out when Symbiosis lands.

others.title: GTA 6 是 PlayStation 和 Xbox 有史以来预购最多的游戏

content.v: It goes without saying (yet here I am saying it) that Grand Theft Auto 6 is going to be huge. We don't really have a sense as to just how huge at this point: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick has boasted that GTA 6 preorder numbers are " unprecedented ," but he's refused to provide specifics because "the raw numbers could be potentially misleading." But huge, for sure.
Now both Sony and Xbox have joined in the 'gonna be huge' chorus, each of them announcing that preorders for GTA 6 are, definitionally, unprecedented .

"Grand Theft Auto 6 is now the most pre-ordered game in the history of PlayStation Store," Sony proclaimed on the PlayStation Blog . "Given this unprecedented demand, we’ve joined with Rockstar Games to allow players to start pre-loading the game nine days early, so they’re ready to play on launch day. We’ve also adopted a rolling midnight launch by country, beginning at 12:00AM NZDT in New Zealand and running across the globe as respective countries hit midnight on November 19."

Xbox made a similar announcement on its own website, calling GTA 6 "the most pre-ordered title of all time on the Microsoft Store" and encouraging users to begin preloading as soon as possible because of "the unprecedented demand" for the game.

Alongside Xbox Series X/S consoles, Xbox said GTA 6 will also be playable on Xbox One consoles through Xbox Cloud Gaming. That service is also available on PC, but Xbox chief strategy officer Matthew Bell confirmed in October that GTA 6 will not be streamable on our platform .

Today marks the first step in our new 10-year strategic partnership with Take-Two. GTA VI, already the most pre-ordered game ever on Microsoft Store, will be playable on XBOX One through cloud gaming when it launches on November 19. November 10, 2026

But while nobody is serving up specifics on the number of GTA 6 copies sold via preorder, we do have a rough indicator of how much money Take-Two expects to make when it comes out of the gate. The publisher is projecting net bookings of $3.35 to $3.5 billion for its current fiscal quarter, "driven by the groundbreaking release of Grand Theft Auto 6" on November 19. That's roughly double what Take-Two took in during the same quarter in its previous year, when it reported net bookings of $1.76 billion.

"The launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 is ten days away and, with pre-orders continuing to reach unprecedented levels, we expect to deliver an historic year for our company," Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick said during yesterday's quarterly financial report.

Take-Two is also projecting a comparably huge net bookings increase for its full year: The company reported total net bookings of $6.72 billion for its 2026 fiscal year, and is currently projecting $8 to $8.2 billion for 2027.
