items.title: GTA 6 粉丝对于 30fps 的确认存在分歧
items.summary: GTA 6 will be 30fps, creating division among fans and frustration for PS5 Pro owners.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/10/gta-6-pre-load-art-1794330386826.jpg
GTA 6 will be 30fps, creating division among fans and frustration for PS5 Pro owners.

Rockstar Games confirmed today that GTA 6 will target 30fps on all consoles , including PS5 Pro. This answers one of the biggest questions that has surrounded the game for years, but the answer also likely isn't a big surprise to many. Given the scope and scale of this game, as well as Rockstar's history with other games, a lot of people assumed this would be a 30fps game. However, there was hope that PS5 Pro would offer 60fps, or at least a 40fps mode as a compromise.

Still, the confirmation is creating all kinds of waves across social media. Some fans are pretty understanding, noting that the trade-off for a lower frame rate is an extremely dense, visually intense game.

"It's a shame they could not get it running at 40-60fps, and it would’ve been way better to play at 60fps, but I also fully understand why this happened," said one fan . "You don’t get to make the most dense, detailed, and graphically intensive game of the generation without making sacrifices."

"GTA 6 has a ton of complex systems running at once and reaching that level of realism while maintaining a stable framerate is impossible due to the CPU bottleneck," explained another fan . "Rockstar Games probably had to choose between cutting down complex systems like NPC density, NPC AI, Cars, Random Events etc. for a higher framerate or keeping those while targeting 30FPS to reach the highest level of realism possible and now we know that they went with the latter."
"30fps in [Red Dead Redemption 2] is good enough," stated a user on X . "As long as input latency is lower and there are no significant frame drops, I think GTA 6 will be alright."

Others are not as generous, however. One fan refunded the Ultimate Edition of GTA 6, noting they'll wait for the inevitable PS6 version that will likely have performance enhancements, possibly including 60fps. A big part of the frustration comes from people who expected more out of the PS5 Pro. Some fans shelled out a lot of extra money for the console, assuming it would give them a notable leap in quality from the base console. While it will have some exclusive features, like ray-traced shadows and PSSR, it's not the jump that some were hoping for.
"People paid over a grand for slightly better upscaling + ray-tracing but still the same 30 fps performance," said a user on X .

"I understand that the game is massive, and that this was (probably) the only way it would’ve even been playable on a console, but damn," said another fan . "It’s 2026. 30fps?! I’m losing excitement for GTA 6 by the day."

"60fps is the floor for modern titles on PS5 Pro and above, not 30...but Rockstar are dragging us back a good 5-10 years here," said an annoyed fan on Reddit . "They knew the hardware capabilities, and chose to make a game that isn't really compatible with it...that's what's crazy here."

Another fan pointed out there may also be some hypocrisy regarding this situation, as games like Starfield have been panned for being 30fps: "No offense towards GTA 6 it will be good, but Starfield got assaulted for being locked to 30fps and runs at 60fps on Xbox and PS5 now, are we gonna have the same energy for GTA 6 being locked to 30fps?"

Many games offer some kind of performance mode to unlock higher frame rates, at the cost of a lower resolution, a lack of ray-tracing, or other compromises. However, it doesn't seem like GTA 6 will have that, much to the annoyance of some fans. Maybe there's a chance Rockstar will add some performance buffs post-launch, but I wouldn't hold my breath. Red Dead Redemption 2 has been stuck at 30fps on consoles since 2018.

There are rumors that a GTA 6 PC port will arrive in early 2027, which would likely be the definitive version of the game with much higher frame rates. Rockstar has yet to confirm any platforms for the game beyond Xbox and PlayStation (though you can play the game on Xbox One through the cloud ), but maybe we'll hear more about a potential PC version in the new year.

Despite some division over performance options, GTA 6 is just nine days away from launch, and the hype is at its peak. Players can pre-load the game starting today , which they absolutely should if they want to play it as soon as it is available. The game will take up nearly 212 GBs, so it may take a while to download, depending on internet speeds. PlayStation and Xbox have also both confirmed that the game is the most pre-ordered title in their respective histories, meaning this game is likely going to shatter all kinds of sales records next week.

items.title: 自我提醒：如果在机场玩《使命召唤》，请不要说“炸弹”之类的词，以免您想要疏散整架飞机
items.summary: Oopsie daisy.

content.v: I'll be the first to admit I've said some incredibly questionable-sounding things while playing videogames. Or talking about them in public. But I would like to think that the one place where I would be extra careful about the words coming out of my mouth are in an airport, or on an airplane. Really, anywhere with an insane amount of security and an ever-pervasive fear of anything explosives-related.

Unfortunately, for passengers on board a Frontier Airlines flight earlier this week, however, one such gamer was not so cautious. As reported by CBS News , one plane at California's Ontario International Airport had to be evacuated over a bomb scare, only for it to be some guy playing Call of Duty with his pal.

According to reports, one passenger overheard words such as "bomb" and "explosion" and, rightly so, went and told staff about it. The situation led to both the plane and the east wing of Terminal 2 being evacuated, and a check of the aircraft which revealed that no explosives or bombs were on board.

After detaining and speaking to the culprit, it was revealed that he was, in fact, on FaceTime with his buddy while playing Call of Duty together. He was released without any charges, and the flight was reboarded and departed later that night.

I do feel a little bad for laughing about it—as a nervous flyer, I know for a fact that if I had been that passenger overhearing the conversation I may very well have gone into full-blown panic mode. I don't even like when someone doesn't put their phone on airplane mode as we're taking off!

But I'm also the type of person to watch my friend's Discord streams while I'm out and about, and I honestly dread to think about the kind of things passerbys have heard me say while spectating games. Hell, I'm sure even my neighbours have heard some absurd sentences leave my mouth when I've been raiding in Final Fantasy 14 with the windows wide open. If you're reading this neighbours, I'm sorry.

items.title: MS 已经杂乱地修补了 Microsoft Paint 安全漏洞，但对于某些人来说，更新仍然没有显示
items.summary: What a shambles.

content.v: I really wasn't expecting Microsoft Paint to turn up in the cybersecurity headlines, but here we are. MS disclosed and patched a security vulnerability within the software on October 13, but it's worth checking your own Paint version to see if you've received the update.

Some users don't have automatic Microsoft Store updates enabled, especially those on work machines. As Paint is updated via the store, you may need to manually update to version 11.2609.401.0 to keep your machine secure.

To confuse things further, International Cyber Digest reports that the MS store was providing older versions to some users until recently, and Windows Latest didn't seem to receive the new version even with auto updates enabled. Or, there's been some mixup with release numbers. It's genuinely difficult to tell at this point, with differing information coming from multiple sources .

The vulnerability was initially given an 8.1 severity rating on the CVSS scale, but Microsoft downgraded it to a 7.0 score on November 9 according to Threat Defence . MS also changed its description of the bug to that of a local exploit (requiring a user to open a crafted file) rather than a network attack vector, .

Regardless, to check whether your Paint version is hopefully up-to-date (what a world we live in), open the app, go to the Settings menu, and check the version number beneath the "About Paint" section. If it's lower than version 11.2609.401.0, open the Microsoft Store and manually update the app. Or, if your Windows 11 settings don't allow user updates, contact your sysadmin.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/hhjwXAmBjTz5rXo7SkJrE8-1920-80.jpg
You can also check your Paint version within Windows Powershell by running:

powershell Get-AppxPackage -Name Microsoft.Paint | Select-Object Name, Version Honestly, this is the biggest omnishambles of conflicting cybersecurity info I've seen in a while. Some outlets initially reported the bug as a no-click security flaw , while others have suggested that the vulnerability could potentially be exploited via a specially crafted image. Microsoft shifting the security goalposts as it goes really hasn't helped, nor has its apparently messy roll out of the patched version.

Anyway, it's still worth checking if Paint has been updated, folks. One way or another, we'll get to the bottom of this eventually. Or we'll just keep updating every aspect of our machines on a tediously regular basis, in the hope that some of these messy leak-plugging antics might do some good.

items.summary: The cheapest way to get the best handheld chip right now.

content.v: Intel's G3 Extreme is a mighty impressive chip, and easily the headline feature of Acer's Predator Atlas 8. If you're looking to get the best handheld Panther Lake chip right now, Acer has swooped in at pretty much the cheapest price point on the market.

And if that's all you want, the Atlas 8 has my blessing. It's a solid device that makes use of the chip and offers compromises in memory and storage capacity (in the American market) to bring that cost down. Not only that, but if you buy one right now, you get a heaping of goodies with it.

But if you don't need top-of-the-line specs to have a good time, the Atlas 8 instead becomes just one of many very, very solid, yet very, very expensive handhelds on offer in a time that has become worse and worse thanks to the memory crisis.
Buy if…
✅ You want the G3 Extreme but cheaper: The Atlas 8 undercuts both MSI and OneXPlayer in pricing for a G3 Extreme handheld.
Don't buy if…
❌ You play fighters or platformers primarily: The D-pad is mushy and lacks distinction, making it unsatisfying and a tad unruly.

items.summary: The growing use of generative AI meant it was "harder to judge what students made themselves."

content.v: The Australian STEM Videogame Challenge , a "free national videogame development competition for students," has confirmed that the rise of generative AI means this year's event will be the last.

The end of the STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) Videogame Challenge was first reported on Reddit last week, when someone claiming to be a judge in the program said they'd received an email informing them that "after 12 wonderful years," the 2026 event would mark its end.

Speculation as to the cause of the program's cancellation focused primarily on the presence of AI in entries: Another self-proclaimed judge said the problem wasn't merely the use of AI in itself but that "some students just completely generate their games with AI."
"How do you mark that? You can't just give them a zero," the judge wrote. "It's so hard to tell what was or wasn't generated using AI, and especially hard since that's the way the industry is going."

That same person also suggested, however, that funding cutbacks could have been an even bigger factor in the decision, saying that "projects like this are the first to get cut" when government budgets get tight.
Now the Australian Council for Educational Research has confirmed that the cancellation was in fact due to AI.

"After more than a decade inspiring the next generation of young creators, the current 2026 Australian STEM Video Game Challenge will be the competition's final chapter," Cathy Zemaitis, Head of the Student Learning and Progress division at ACER, told PC Gamer.

"The decision was driven by the rapid and complex rise of generative AI in game development, making it harder to judge what students made themselves, and moving the program away from its original purpose."

So, that's that: A program aimed at encouraging kids to learn has come to an end because the kids learned how to get around the learning part. It's sad, although as a former high school reprobate myself I can't be too critical of the young'uns for doing what they do. I do wonder, though, what all of this might say about our future: Where will we be when we know how to prompt, but not how to create?

Zemaitis added that organizers are not looking at ways to adjust the program to accommodate generative AI: "There are no plans to pursue alternative options for delivering the Australian STEM Videogame Challenge, however we're always looking for how we can partner with schools and the sector more broadly to deliver programs that enrich the learning experience of students." She also encouraged educators looking for other ways to "keep students challenged" to check out the International Mathematical Modelling Challenge .

items.summary: Seems like an easy install, too. Though not everyone is convinced it's worth it.

content.v: DLSS 5 has been out for a while now, love it or hate it , but obviously not for AMD cards. Well, not officially, anyway. We have previously seen and tried mods that get the machine learning-aided neural rendering tech up and running using AMD RX 9000-series silicon, and now it looks like there's a significantly improved one.

AMDLSS5 version 2.0 is now out (via Wccftech ), and it's claiming some impressive improvements compared to other DLSS 5 mods. Specifically, compared with "other mods", it's claiming +64% fps in Resident Evil Requiem, and +11% fps compared with the previous version of this one.

That's particularly great, if true, because our Dave's testing of DLSS 5 on an AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT using a different mod was, erm, not pretty. We're talking just 9 fps in Cyberpunk 2077, admittedly at 4K res on RT Ultra settings, but that was with FSR 4 on and set to Balanced.

It's not all the mod's fault, though, as DLSS 5 itself can be very intensive to run, even on an Nvidia GPU. Our Andy found this out when he tried running it in NBA 2K27 . Frame rates there dropped up to 73% at 4K while using an RTX 5080 , and there were significant drops at lower resolutions, too.

content.v: The next batch of games for the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog has been revealed. PS Plus Essential and Premium subscribers can grab 10 games in total this month, starting November 11. In the US and UK, several of these games will roll out later in the month.

This month's headline act is Death Stranding 2: On the Beach , a post-apocalyptic open-world game from the mind of Hideo Kojima. A game about human connection at its core, Death Stranding 2 is a polarizing and delightfully weird game, so if the idea of GTA 6's bustling metropolis doesn't appeal to you, then maybe couriering packages in a desolate Australian landscape might appeal to you.

Or if you want the hustle and bustle of a sandbox without the consequences GTA 6 is teasing, Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii is worth checking out. This spin-off features fan-favorite character Majima as the protagonist, and as you'd expect from a Yakuza game, it's downright strange, melodramatic, and action-packed.

Other highlights this month include the Dragon Quest 3 HD-2D Remake for a modernized spin on a JRPG classic, survival-action meets the irradiated British countryside in Atomfall , and Trepang 2 is a blistering blast of first-person action.

The hardcore World War Two first-person shooter Hell Let Loose features massive multiplayer battles, and if you're feeling sporty, you can attempt to hit a six in Cricket 2026 or taunt gravity with some exceptionally tight cornering in MotoGP 26.

items.summary: Hello from Arrowhead, Helldivers! Our latest game update, Update 7.2, has been out for a few weeks now as well

content.v: Hello from Arrowhead, Helldivers!

Our latest game update, Update 7.2, has been out for a few weeks now as well as hotfixes. As part of our continued commitment to improved transparency, here are the team’s latest reflections and our next steps for development based on this update.

We poured a lot of work into the features you’ve been playing this Fall, some of which you’re actively discovering in-game over the last week (and which hit late compared to our content roadmap - more on this below). Since August you’ve collectively invaded and collapsed the Void, fought Illuminate Crushers and Wretches, activated the Terminid Control System+, celebrated Liberty Day, adopted a SEAF, provided a tank in every Super Earth citizen's driveway and more: not bad for three months!

While Helldivers have plenty to celebrate recently, you’ve raised very valid concerns that some changes haven’t landed as well as we wanted, including the timing of features announced in our roadmap and the impact the move to Easy Anti-Cheat had on unsupported mods.
We hear your feedback on these topics and more and we want to outline our plans for what actions we’re taking with your collective experiences in mind.

We built the second roadmap around HELLDIVERS 2 patch release dates rather than when the content in those updates would be available in the game. Our patches run roughly six weeks apart meaning Update 7.2 came on October 20 and the content is due to unfold over the next six weeks until Update 8.0 in early December. This wasn’t clear in the roadmap graphic and understandably created confusion, which was never our goal. Moving forward, we will present a clearer schedule of when content is slated to go live while preserving the mystery of the Galactic War’s trajectory, its surprises, and its plot twists.

Additionally, let’s discuss the new biome listed in the October section of the roadmap. Update 7.2 expanded on the caves first previewed with Into The Unjust and adapted this feature to work across more biomes. Advanced by the Galactic War events involving the Terminid Control System+ that spread the Gloom, subterranean Terminid infestations can now occur on all non-ice planets which can lead to them becoming new hive worlds if they aren’t swiftly liberated. These procedurally generated caves now retain features of their planet’s biome and are thematic to the world they spawn in. This is a new instrument available to our Game Masters in how they conduct the Galactic War and weave storylines in HELLDIVERS 2. However, we are aware that our phrasing of “new biome” in the roadmap sets a certain expectation that this addition does not fully meet - we apologize for the miscommunication and will be more prescriptive with future announcements.

Your input matters and we’re sorry this roadmap wasn’t as accurate as it should have been, Helldivers. While we aren’t announcing a date for it in this article, our next roadmap will demonstrate the impact of your feedback.

Real talk. We said in a blog earlier this year that we set up a strike team to work on addressing Hellpod steering behaviour and Stratagem ball targeting and bouncing. Their new designs have been in active development since the release of Devoid of Liberty , and are actively being playtested internally and need more iterations before they’re released.

As these fixes required substantial adjustments to both mechanics while taking into account all edge cases, we plan for a few more rounds of playtesting to ensure they’re ready to go live. This does mean these fixes will likely not go live with HELLDIVERS 2’s next major update. However, the team’s confidence in these adjustments is high so you should hopefully not have to wait that much longer to see these much-requested feature updates in action. Thanks for your patience!

There has been a lot of discussion around Easy Anti-Cheat. You can read our intention for switching to this anti-cheat solution here . We added Easy Anti-Cheat for one reason: to reduce the number of cheaters joining your missions and ruining the experience. On that front, we think we’re taking steps in the right direction.

However, we do see that this change means that some PC players lost the use of fan-made game mods. While all mods are not officially supported, we have been reviewing how the code changes disabled cosmetic non-gameplay mods. This has resulted in adjustments that should allow some cosmetic mods to be functional with our next hotfix.

As for gameplay mods, these adjustments alter the game code or game memory in a way that can impact game stability for yourself and the others in your lobby, generating client crashes and unexpected match outcomes. While mods can seem innocuous, anything that touches the game code or game memory can have major impacts on the gameplay experience. Running any mod that affects the game itself presents a risk to your account and, from a technical perspective, is indistinguishable from an attempt to cheat. These mods will continue to be prohibited in an ongoing effort to eradicate cheating and game-breaking modifications. Accounts determined to be using such gameplay mods may be banned from HELLDIVERS 2.

To determine whether a mod affects gameplay on PC and should not be used, start by validating your installation’s Steam files which will verify your installation is aligned with the official version of the game. If you choose to utilize non-gameplay mods at this point, please know they are not officially supported and may cause game crashes or poor performance.
We have outlined the following steps to check that a cosmetic mod is functional AFTER the hotfix is published.
If mods were previously installed, please reinstall the game.
Verify game file integrity by following these instructions from Steam .
Start the game and confirm it's running as intended.
Incrementally add cosmetic mods and reverify game file integrity to validate which ones are functional.

We’re also tracking reports that virtual machines can no longer access the game since the last update. For those who are affected and have raised customer support tickets, we are looking to update on next steps as soon as possible.
The teams are currently deep in planning mode for the next year of HELLDIVERS 2 with several major updates and intense campaigns taking shape.
Part of this process is evaluating the top community topics to inform which existing features should be refined for quality-of-life improvements as well as keep expanding the core of the game.
What’s sooner than 2027? Our next major update in early December! Here are some of the changes on the way, already locked in for in this upcoming release:
Jump, Hover, and Warp packs will now be usable while carrying two-handed items. This was previously not possible and allows for the introduction of new loadout combinations. (line edited for clarity)
The Hellbomb backpack will be able to be armed or picked up from the ground using long-press interact.
All gas clouds will no longer slow the march of the Helldivers.

items.title: Alienware AW3226Q OLED 游戏显示器评测
items.summary: RGB-stripe OLED awesomeness for way less money.

content.v: You know Alienware's 5K2K 39-inch ultrawide OLED gaming monitor beast, the AW3926QW , the one I reviewed the other day? It's an absolute beauty, probably my favourite current PC monitor, save for one niggly flaw. But what if you fancy something similar, but cheaper and in a more conventional 32-inch 4K form factor? Well, give it up for the new Alienware AW3226Q , because it ticks all those boxes.

Notably, it sports exactly the same LG Tandem WOLED panel tech as its bigger 39-inch sibling. That includes being the latest RGB-stripe variant of that new LG OLED panel generation that everyone is going bananas for.

Well, it's nearly the same. For reasons that aren't entirely clear, this 32-inch 4K panel clocks in at 250 nits full-screen brightness and 1,000 nits peak HDR. The aforementioned 39 incher rocks 300 nits and 1,300 nits figures for the same metrics, respectively.

✅ You're an OLED purist: LG's new RGB-stripe WOLED tech offers beautifully neutral colours.
Do not buy if...
❌ You want the brightest possible OLED experience: This version of LG's Tandem WOLED panel technology takes a small brightness hit.

As it happens, the numbers for this 32-inch 4K model are actually more in line with expectations for this panel type. The thing is, with all previous WOLED panel generations, LG used a white subpixel to boost brightness.
This new pure RGB-stripe—or red, green, blue—item ditches the white subpixel in favour of pixel precision and improved colour volume. But that comes with a cost in terms of peak brightness.

Even the 39-inch AW3926QW is a little dimmer than the RGWB version of LG's latest Tandem OLED monitor panel tech, where the "W" in "RGWB" indicates the added white subpixel. Oh, and just for clarity, the "W" in "WOLED" has always referred to the white colour of the light produced by the emissive OLED material in all of the subpixels, rather than the added white subpixels in all previous WOLED monitor generations prior to the newest RGB-stripe variants. Baffling, but there you go.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Dk36Rnnv9zbQFMaKYkk6sV-1920-80.jpg

Anywho, monitors with RGWB Tandem OLED panels, including the Asus ROG Strix XG32UQWMS I reviewed recently, tend to weigh in around 330 nits full-screen and 1,500 nits peak HDR. So the 39-inch 5K2K RGB-stripe panel gives less away in terms of brightness than expected, and in turn this new 32-inch 4K model is pretty much where you'd expect it to be.

Got all that? Then it's also worth understanding that those brightness figures can be misleading. Like I said, LG has been including a fourth white subpixel in all of its previous WOLED monitor panel generations to boost brightness. But that doesn't automatically boost colour brightness. At least it can't while maintaining colour volume.

That's why Samsung's competing QD-OLED panels, as also used by a wide variety of monitor makers including Alienware, have often looked more vibrant despite typically offering slightly lower ratings. Samsung has never used an additional white subpixel, so its brightness rating reflects real-world usage. And real-world gaming means a colour image rather than a pure white image pretty much all the time.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/wh4KNV97ho2JPHbnVKduab-1920-80.jpg

The point I'm making here is that it's important not to assume that the 4K RGB-stripe Tandem WOLED panel in this new Alienware is a step backwards just because it has lower brightness ratings than RGWB Tandem WOLED in monitors like that Asus model I mentioned above. It's more complicated than that.

Along with the brightness and colour volume implications, the RGB-stripe has the same pixel precision and text quality upsides here as it does on other RGB-stripe OLEDs. In short, the Windows OS assumes it is rendering to a conventional RGB-stripe subpixel layout, so having RGB-stripe solves issues like fuzzy text and colour fringing.
It's important not to assume that the 4K RGB-stripe Tandem WOLED panel in this new Alienware is a step backwards just because it has lower brightness ratings.

As for the rest of the speeds and feeds, well, the refresh is a relatively modest 165 Hz, the panel is flat, and it's covered in a glossy glare coating. Inputs include DisplayPort 1.4 and two HDMI 2.1 ports, but there's no USB-C for single-cable connectivity, albeit along with the two USB-A data ports, there is a USB–C downstream socket as part of the USB hub.

Oh, and I haven't mentioned the price. It's $699 or £649 at launch, which is pretty punchy, especially given the cutting-edge panel tech. Heck, the 34-inch ultrawide AW3426DW is more expensive. It's also not far off half the price of the Asus ROG Swift PG32UCWM , which has the same RGB-stripe panel, albeit running at a higher refresh and with more features.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/uBxsqMwfrvLCuWWH8CLEYi-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/m9xyxN6BZ4wNmwNXiRaZGn-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/KJzvqK86SEaqqZcUiCqhw3-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/iUsy8fUVVQ6FRuFqN5kUW7-1920-80.jpg

So, the surprisingly low price perhaps explains the 165 Hz as opposed to 240 Hz refresh and lack of USB-C support. It's probably also why there's no dual-mode support offering a higher refresh rate at a lower resolution.

If that's the stats and specs covered, what's the actual gaming experience like? Mostly pretty fantastic. Like the bigger AW3926QW, I really like the AW3226Q's overall look and colour balance. It fixes the slightly washed out and green-tinted vibe of LG's RGWB panels without suffering from the overly warm colour temperature and purple-tint in bright ambient light of competing Samsung QD-OLED-based monitors.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/cZqwGtVJEdYBDFvCfezEyB-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/cnL4eGHMHpoyNkdf5XpcYE-1920-80.jpg

In many ways, this is the perfect OLED panel tech, it's just so nice . The colours look super natural, the lighting control is perfect, and the response is basically instant. The 4K resolution on a 32-inch panel also makes for razor-sharp detail. It's pretty much the definitive modern PC gaming experience.

OKay, the 165 Hz refresh is a touch pedestrian these days, but this isn't an esports model and it's definitely a compromise built out of chasing affordability. And even with an RTX 5090 , you're not going to be playing many modern games at 4K at 200fps-plus, in reality.
It's pretty much the definitive modern PC gaming experience.

The arguable exception to all that is full-screen brightness, which is just a touch disappointing. A lot of the time you won't notice it. On the Windows desktop if you enable dark mode and you haven't got a very bright browser or app window open, this monitor looks really punchy and vibrant.

The same goes for most game scenes with HDR enabled. They look absolutely stellar, with both bright and dark image elements precisely controlled in the same image. That's OLED per-pixel lighting for you, there's nothing quite like it. As ever, of course, the sizzle of small HDR highlights like light sources, sparks and explosions are a sight to behold.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/fkAvyA8ZeduXbLbMHzgb7o-1920-80.jpg

Where this RGB-stripe 32 incher isn't quite so impressive is brighter outdoor game scenes. Here, it can look just a bit dull, with that 250 nit full-screen capability holding it back. To an extent, the 39-inch 5K2K model has the same problem. But it's that little bit brighter. We're talking fine margins, but where the 39 incher mostly seems to be just punchy enough, this 32-inch sibling just falls short of being enjoyably vibrant that little bit more often.

items.title: 把圈外人都拉入坑的奥克兰玩家嘉年华，和腾讯这款天花板产品有关
items.summary: ■ 1. 如果选一个词来形容刚刚结束的ExileCon 2026，我会想到“大型桌游现场”。 今年是第三届ExileCon——这是由《流放之路》系列开发商Grinding Gear Games（后称GGG）举办的全球玩家

content.v: 如果选一个词来形容刚刚结束的ExileCon 2026，我会想到“大型桌游现场”。
今年是第三届ExileCon——这是由《流放之路》系列开发商Grinding Gear Games（后称GGG）举办的全球玩家嘉年华，融合游戏新内容发布、现场试玩、开发者交流和玩家社区活动于一身。

时隔3年，GGG再次举办ExileCon，其中一个很重要的原因是：《流放之路2》经过两年的Early Access（抢先体验），即将在12月推出免费的1.0正式版本，而由腾讯运营的国服《流放之路：降临》也将采用这套完整内容。而在这么大版本的更新下，宣告转免费更是一次有勇气的尝试——这也与游戏即服务（GaaS）的理念相符。国服《流放之路：降临》此前已通过降价、不定期折扣、1元体验活动等多种形式让更多玩家以更低的门槛体验到瓦尔克拉斯大陆的魅力，在26年底宣告转免便是水到渠成。
受腾讯《流放之路》国服邀请，我第一次来到ExileCon。现场玩家来自世界各地，大部分是专门从海外飞来参与活动的，甚至有相当多的中国玩家。很多没有能亲自来到现场的国服玩家，也通过同步直播转播体验了ExileCon的全过程，直播间在线观看人数直奔“999+”。只不过让我有点意外的是，现场最受玩家欢迎的活动是《奥杜尔符文》——这是GGG为ExileCon特供的现场限定小游戏。
包括我在内，每位来到ExileCon的玩家都会在入场时随机收到一组卡牌，卡牌对应《流放之路》系列中的基础装备。GGG 的员工则会在现场扮演怪物，他们穿着印有怪物名称和攻防属性的 T 恤。玩家可以打出对应要求的卡牌，战胜对方，获得随机掉落的新装备卡牌和制作材料——工作人员也会通过贴纸等方式，为卡牌增加属性、提升品质，随着装备不断完善，玩家便能挑战更强的怪物和首领，争取更好的奖励。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-09/4426af1d7e57845d.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
这套卡牌游戏的设计很有意思。《流放之路》是一款强调装备随机掉落和角色构筑的ARPG，卡牌玩法保留了游戏中的核心循环：打怪、获取装备、制作装备，再不断调整自己的Build。也因此，来到现场之后，我要做的不只是观看演讲、试玩游戏或购买周边，更像是真的进入了一个小型的瓦尔克拉斯大陆。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-09/2706af1d7b310676.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
“轻松”、“亲切”，是ExileCon给人最直观的感受。这也和Jonathan对整个ExileCon的期待相同。在进入会场之初，每当我犹豫要不要试试卡牌对战的时候，不经意和扮演怪物的开发者对上眼神，他们立即会主动示意让我去挑战他们。我还看到一些开发者，不仅自己扮演怪物，自己也在寻找不同的同事参加对战。
在挑战原始鬼灵（Primal Spirit）时，我和它的扮演者、负责游戏引擎开发的Thomas聊了几句。Thomas告诉我，有一些人会主动去挑自己想扮演的怪物，有一些人是来到现场的当天，随机领到的角色。也因此，不只是玩家，他们的一些同事也是现场才学会的规则。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-09/3966af1d7a347e3f.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
“几乎所有员工都来了。”另一位开发者和我说。他负责初代作品《流放之路》相关内容，而《流放之路》将在11月13日迎来赛季更新，忙碌的周末结束之后，他没办法休息，需要立马投入到新赛季更新内容的工作中。
“还有很多事情没有处理完。虽然有些累，但不管怎么说，这是一个很好地跟玩家以及同事见面的机会。”他告诉我，“并且因为平时我专注于《流放之路》的内容，没有时间了解《流放之路2》的进展，但我一直非常好奇他们在开发的新东西，所以也正好来了解一下情况。”
这位开发者提到的新内容，便是在今年的ExileCon主题演讲环节正式公布的新职业暗影（Shadow）。作为ExileCon最重要的环节，主题演讲也延续了Jonathan提到的“轻松、亲切”氛围。
通常来说，在如此关键的场合，为避免出错或者出糗，游戏公司会选择以播片的方式来展示新职业的玩法。但GGG选择让《流放之路2》游戏总监Mark Roberts现场操作。在Mark上台前，Jonathan还开玩笑说：“这次尽量不要死，好吧？”这句话引起了现场玩家的一片笑声。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-09/5186af1d6cb3a71d.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
“游戏策划一定要玩游戏”，是中文玩家社区流传甚广的一句话。Mark显然一直都在玩，而且他本身就是因为玩得够好，才加入的GGG。加入工作室之后，Mark一边工作，一边仍能在《流放之路》竞速赛（One Month Race）中保持前20名。
这次在现场，Mark为大家演示了将在1.0版本推出的新职业暗影。十几分钟的时间，他熟练地使用潜行、布置陷阱，切换不同的技能组合，向玩家展示了暗影的多种玩法，最后还成功击败了区域首领“阿曼多，堕落之猪”（Armando the Showman）。
只不过，演示中途出现了一个小插曲：Mark不小心被一只金色精英怪Gemling Lieutenant（古灵副官）的一记重击直接击倒。现场玩家立刻发出一阵哄笑。
更意外的是，Mark的这次暴毙还提前曝光了一项此前尚未公布的新功能——死亡回顾（Death Summary），在即将更新的1.0版本中，制作团队进行了包括死亡回放、性能优化在内大量底层体验功能的更新。从展示界面中，玩家可以看到角色死亡前受到的伤害及其构成。注意到这一新功能后，现场玩家的掌声变得更热烈，甚至有人吹起了口哨。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-09/8436af1d782d7e4d.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
“现在正好借这个机会告诉大家，我们做了死亡回顾功能。”Jonathan顺势在台上救场说，“好了，让我们回到刚才被打断的演示中吧。”
演示过程中被重要展现的暗影、决斗者两个新增基础职业，和配套的全新升华分支，是这次演讲的重点之一。
暗影以匕首和陷阱为主要攻击手段，并为《流放之路2》带来了一套全新的潜行机制。进入潜行状态后，玩家可以避开一定范围外怪物的侦测，再选择目标，利用技能迅速接近敌人并发动伏击。部分技能在潜行状态下还会获得额外效果。这让暗影有了不同于传统近战职业的战斗方式。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-09/5376af1d755db3fe.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
每当Jonathan介绍到新职业的关键机制，现场玩家都会用掌声和欢呼回应。我印象最深的一次，发生在他介绍决斗者（Duelist）的时候。
决斗者并不是这次ExileCon才首次公开的职业，它此前已经在今年的Gamescom上亮相。这次演讲主要展示了它的两个新升华职业，其中一个是骑士（Knight）。骑士最特别的设计，是可以召唤一名侍从（Squire）。
当侍从出现在屏幕上时，现场玩家的反应各不相同：有人惊呼，有人鼓掌，也有人看到侍从的模样后忍不住笑了起来。因为它看起来确实有点像个刚入门的“菜鸟”。Jonathan在现场稍微平静后补充：“不过，一旦有人归你指挥，你的责任就是为他们配齐装备。”
玩家们立刻欢呼起来。和一般的召唤物不同，骑士的侍从可以由玩家直接配置装备和技能宝石。它使用什么武器、掌握哪些技能，都由玩家决定。换句话说，玩家不仅要考虑自己的角色构筑，还要为侍从安排一套独立的装备和技能组合。这也为《流放之路：降临》的召唤物玩法增加了新的构筑空间。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-09/6066af1d73b6b9ce.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
除了新增职业外，Jonathan也介绍了即将到来的1.0版本更新的全貌。在历经两年抢先体验阶段后，这次版本的更新体量堪称海量：补全第五、六章主线剧情，推出系列规模最大的单人章节；上线全新赛季玩法“瓦尔克拉斯征服者”，加入攻城、阵营争夺、领地征伐的大规模对抗机制；同时追加数百款全新装备、天赋节点、传奇基底，重做大量BD体系。
在演讲现场，Jonathan花了近两个小时才介绍完这些内容——现在，你已经能立刻在社交平台刷到国服主播们对这些内容的总结和补充；而且，这些内容全部都将随1.0版本永久免费向所有玩家开放，这让这次更新在刷宝ARPG赛道里显得格外有分量。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-09/5296af1d714943b7.png?imageView2/2/w/700
在我看来，在刷宝ARPG大多以小步迭代的赛季为核心节奏的行业环境下，《流放之路2》这种一次性交付的超量完整内容，在传统刷宝、构筑配装的核心框架之上，塞入了完整长线叙事、大规模阵营攻防、全新职业体系等大量跨维度内容，无疑拓展了刷宝品类的空间，对整个赛道来说也是一次标志性的尝试。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-09/1916af1d6f8c129a.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
随《流放之路2》正式1.0接下来的上线，GGG将进入同时运营两款大型ARPG的新阶段。可以预见，上线后，“流放之路”系列的玩家规模还将迎来新一轮增长。在媒体群访中，我不由有些好奇：GGG将如何应对同时开发和运营两款游戏带来的挑战？
Jonathan告诉我，过去几年里，GGG为了实现两款游戏的同步开发，对工作室的组织架构进行了多次调整。如今，两个项目已经基本分成了相对独立的团队：《流放之路》的具体开发工作主要由Octavian和Andrew负责，而Jonathan和Mark则将更多精力放在《流放之路2》上。
“当然，我依然会参与各种方案的讨论，但现在更多是以顾问的身份提供建议。真正负责执行和推进《流放之路》开发工作的是他们。”Jonathan说，“让整个工作室具备同时开发两款游戏的能力，过去确实是一件非常困难的事情。不过现在我们终于能够做到。”
在整个介绍和交流的过程中，我也能感受到他对各个地区玩家的重视——比如，在提问环节，Jonathan在一些问题中会特意提到“中国玩家也非常关心这一点”。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-09/5386af1d6ea33a09.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
GGG目前一共有265名员工。这对一家位于新西兰的游戏工作室来说，并不容易。新西兰远离欧美等传统游戏开发中心，本地人才储备相对有限，游戏开发又是一个高度依赖人才的行业。何况，他们需要面对非常多来自不同地区、拥有不同文化的玩家群体，尤其还有广阔的中国玩家。
Jonathan向我们透露说，他坚持亲自面试每一位员工。在他看来，面对面的交流非常重要，他喜欢直接和员工沟通。“我们工作室基本不开正式会议。需要沟通时，我会直接去找相关同事，或者让他们来找我。”Jonathan说，“对我而言，最不能放弃的，就是和员工、和玩家面对面交流。”
从这个角度看，无论ExileCon现场卡牌游戏让玩家和开发者面对面的设计，还是主题演讲时，游戏总监亲自上场为玩家演示游戏玩法内容，GGG与玩家的沟通方式，似乎都是Jonathan在这一理念上的延续。而在下周二，他还将亲自来到上海，和国服玩家面对面。
而在国区专访环节，一位《流放之路：降临》主播提到，在0.5和0.5.5版本期间，他在中国社区组织了两轮专家独狼自力赛季。他想要知道，GGG今后是否会为这类比赛提供更多支持，比如私人赛季、可调整的规则或词缀，他也希望中国玩家未来在赛事方面获得GGG的支持。
“当然，我确实希望多做一些这方面的事情。”Jonathan爽快地回答，“二代目前还没有太多时间来做这些，不过大家肯定有兴趣。我非常愿意推进这件事，也想在私人赛季方面做得更多，我认为会很有意思。”
活动最后一天下午，创始人圆桌结束后，Chris Wilson和Jonathan一起出现在见面会的签名桌前。Chris Wilson是GGG的联合创始人，也是初代《流放之路》的灵魂制作人，他在2023年底卸任了公司的管理职务，在2024年短暂宣布退休之后，他又在2025年创立了新的工作室，准备开发一款规模“比《流放之路》小得多”的游戏。
其实，前一天我就看到Chris站在会场的一个角落里，想找他合影、交流的玩家在一旁排起了长队。想想这两天的ExileCon，我始终觉得这里有一种难得的纯粹。即使已经离开GGG，Chris依然会回到ExileCon来，也依然受到玩家的尊重和喜爱——无论你是游戏公司的创始人、开发者，还是远道而来的玩家，当你来到ExileCon，又都成为了瓦尔克拉斯大陆的一部分。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-09/1856af1d6950fbc1.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
举办这次的ExileCon的场地奥蒂亚中心一共能容纳2000多人，活动门票很早就售罄了。在第一届ExileCon举办时，Chris曾透露过，当时《流放之路》的玩家只有不到1%是新西兰本地玩家，而当年参加ExileCon的人里，有超过90%来自海外，许多中国玩家甚至是远渡重洋奔赴南半球。是什么吸引这么多人，愿意为了一款游戏的线下活动飞超过10小时的路程？
我们或许可以从其他地方知晓答案——今年5月，新版本“远古回响”推出后，《流放之路：降临》在国内B站、NGA等玩家平台收获了大量好评，1.0版本的转免预约也是国服玩家之间持续热门的话题。这证明了在持续更新的过程中，它始终能够持续吸引大量玩家回到游戏，也验证了GGG一直以来的思路：不靠付费锁内容，而是把一整套打磨完成的庞大玩法、故事交给玩家。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-11-10/7206af32c439cb1c.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
那些没有能实际前来，选择在线上观看活动的国内外玩家，也纷纷在直播评论里留下相当热情的文字。其中点赞最高的一条是：“没有哪家公司能像 GGG 这样。能够成为他们的玩家，本身就是一种荣幸。谢谢你们！”
而在下周二，《流放之路：降临》国服1.0前瞻试玩会将在上海举办，Jonathan也会来到现场，和国服玩家面对面交流。届时，国服玩家也能试玩到ExileCon揭晓的全新职业。
虽然，就和所有的持续运营游戏一样，或许对于GGG和腾讯国服来说，当1.0版本正式上线时，挑战才真正开始。但就像有玩家说的那样：“过去两年很愉快，希望接下来还能再有二十年。”对他们来说，期待早在更早之前就开始产生了。

items.title: 我与皇后和骑士战斗，但不知何故，我在堆叠顺序（下一个伟大的套牌构建者）中最难对付的对手是两只鸟
items.summary: Those birds kept stealing all my good cards.

content.v: What's worse than fighting one human-sized bird with sunglasses? Fighting two human-sized birds with sunglasses. That wasn't a usual problem in my everyday life until I started playing Stack Order's demo , the hand-drawn deckbuilder that's full of duels and fantastic combos.

The run began with my masked character locked away in a jail cell, not all that dissimilar to how I start most of my days. However, this time I was promptly freed by a stranger who wanted to help out. After handing me a deck of cards and talking me through how to use it, I was left to go on my merry way. The only problem was that I didn't get very far before a knight called Robert, who was very unhappy to see me out of my cell, butted in.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/549MnU6RRpTbpnFaAtc3gm-1920-80.jpg

I've played my fair share of deckbuilders so it wasn't exactly a steep learning curve. But unlike some other games, Stack Order puts a very strong emphasis on stacking cards. You need to lose the bad habit of just playing one card at a time and instead start stacking cards at the first chance you get.

But, crucially, stacking cards doesn't necessarily mean you have to use them, you could get everything ready and then forfeit your go or just use a throwaway attack. Most killing blows in Stack Order come down all at once after you've stacked several cards all with varying multipliers and unleash it all at once.

Certain cards, for example, deal extra damage if they come before or after cards, others add damage to specific cards if they're stacked below them. You get a random assortment of cards on each turn, so you can't always bet on a dream stack, but if you're smart you can usually create one hell of a combo.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/qmgaiMubeGEDQY9sxRarCn-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/vEstgbyv53pBcqcNEf4F9n-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/xxJhP4sisWe7GeeLdSstHn-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/v6HCuP7vznD7GmgfRGtb6n-1920-80.jpg

The only problem is that you're not the only one who can pack a punch. Each enemy I came up against had their own set of skills which changed the fight. Knight Robert had a simple yet effective attack / block combo, the Queen slowly poisoned me, but the birds, those two damn birds really topped it all.

First off there were two of them, which meant extra attacks, but to make matters worse each bird had a special effect that would see them deal extra damage the more cards you left on the table and would steal either the top of bottom card of each stack and use it to buff themselves, including how much they were able to heal. This made things really tricky.

I quickly found out that if I didn't kill them quickly we'd roll into a painfully long stalemate, as I would just barely hang on with shields and they were able to heal 11 damage every third turn. Damage them enough and you can break some of their attacks, they'll still deal damage but won't get the bonus perk.

Managing how you build stacks, when you can't build multiple and also need to leave a sacrifice card for one of the birds to eat, is taxing to be sure. But that's what makes winning fights in Stack Order all the more rewarding.

I managed to experience this euphoria after I bested the pair of birds, but that wasn't the last I'd see of them as, after dying to the next boss, I had to restart my run. Soon I was fighting Robert, the Queen, and the dastardly bird duo all over again, and let me tell you it does not get easier the second time you fight them.
